text.zh: 米娅今天在家里和好朋友们庆祝她的七岁生日。他们玩有趣的抢椅子游戏，吃甜美的巧克力生日蛋糕。米娅吹灭了七根明亮的蜡烛，许下一个秘密的心愿。

text.en: A nimble brown squirrel climbs quickly up the tall oak tree trunk. It carries a heavy round acorn carefully inside its chubby cheeks. The smart squirrel buries the nut safely underground for cold winter days.
text.zh: 一只敏捷的棕色松鼠快速爬上高大的橡树干。它用丰满的腮帮子小心地夹着一颗沉重的圆橡子。这只聪明的松鼠把坚果安全地埋在地下，备战寒冷的冬日。

What food does the squirrel carry?
Where does the squirrel store the acorn while carrying it?
Where does the squirrel bury the nut?
Why does the squirrel bury the nut?
How is the squirrel described in the passage?

text.en: Lucy and her mother mix flour, butter, and sugar in a glass bowl. They shape the sweet dough into round stars and heart patterns. Soon delicious chocolate chip cookies bake golden in the warm oven.
text.zh: 露西和妈妈在玻璃碗里混合面粉、黄油和糖。她们把甜面团塑造圆星和爱心图案。很快，美味的巧克力碎曲奇在温暖的烤箱里烘烤成金黄色。

questions.q: Who bakes cookies together?
What ingredients do they mix in the glass bowl?
What shapes do they make with the dough?
What kind of cookies do they bake?
Where do the cookies bake?
What color do the cookies turn when baked?

text.en: Dan spends his summer vacation visiting his uncle's organic vegetable farm. He helps collect fresh brown eggs from noisy hens every morning. Dan also feeds sweet green hay to gentle horses in the barn.
text.zh: 丹在叔叔的有机蔬菜农场度过暑假。他每天早上帮忙从吵闹的母鸡那里收集新鲜的棕色鸡蛋。丹还在马厩里给温顺的马喂甜绿干草。

questions.q: Where does Dan spend his summer vacation?
What does Dan collect every morning?
Which animals lay the eggs?
What food does Dan feed to the horses?
Where are the gentle horses located?
How are the horses described?

text.en: Our neighborhood library opened a new toy borrowing section for young kids. Children can pick fun puzzle games and wooden blocks to take home. Everyone learns to share and return toys neatly on schedule.
text.zh: 我们的社区图书馆为幼儿开设了一个新的玩具借阅区。孩子们可以挑选有趣的拼图游戏和木质积木带回家。大家学习按时分享并整洁地归还玩具。

questions.q: What new section opened in the library?
Who can borrow toys from this section?
What toys can children pick?
Where do children take the borrowed toys?
What important habit do children learn?
options: To share and return toys neatly

questions.q: Where is the library located?

text.en: Leo rides his new blue bicycle along the safe park trail after school. He wears a sturdy red safety helmet tightly on his head. His elder brother rides beside him to keep him safe and happy.
text.zh: 放学后，利奥骑着他的新蓝色自行车在安全的公园步道上前进。他头戴一顶结实的红色安全头盔。他的哥哥骑在他身边，保护他的安全与快乐。

questions.q: What color is Leo's new bicycle?
Where does Leo ride his bicycle?
When does Leo ride his bike?
What safety gear does Leo wear?
Who rides beside Leo to keep him safe?
How is the park trail described?

text.en: Amy gazes up at the magnificent night sky through her small telescope. She spots bright glowing constellations and the silver full moon clearly. Her eyes shine with wonder as she learns about outer space.
text.zh: 艾米通过她的小望远镜仰望壮丽的夜空。她清晰地看到了明亮发光的星座和银色的满月。当她了解外太空时，她的眼睛闪烁着惊奇的光芒。

questions.q: What tool does Amy use to look at the night sky?
What does Amy spot in the night sky?
options: Bright constellations and the full moon

questions.q: What color is the full moon?
What topic is Amy learning about?
How do Amy's eyes shine as she learns?
How is the night sky described?

desc.en: Learn when to use 'a' and 'an'.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 'a' 和 'an'。

rule.en: Use 'a' before consonant sounds and 'an' before vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u).
rule.zh: 辅音发音前用 'a'，元音发音（a, e, i, o, u）前用 'an'。

questions.q: I have ___ cat.
She sees ___ elephant.
He eats ___ red apple.
This is ___ orange book.
We saw ___ big dog.
I want ___ ice cream cone.
Look at ___ umbrella over there.

desc.en: Learn to use I, You, He, She, It, We, and They.
desc.zh: 学习使用 I, You, He, She, It, We, They。

rule.en: Use He for a boy, She for a girl, It for a thing/animal, and They for more than one person.
rule.zh: 男用 He，女用 She，物体/动物用 It，复数用 They。

questions.q: Tom is my friend. ___ is seven years old.
Lily is singing. ___ has a nice voice.
The sun is bright. ___ is in the sky.
Sam and Ben are playing. ___ love soccer.
My mom and I are cooking. ___ are making soup.
Look at the cute puppy. ___ is sleeping.
Anna and Mary are sisters. ___ walk to school together.

desc.en: Add -s or -es to make words plural.
desc.zh: 在词尾加 -s 或 -es 表示复数。

rule.en: Add '-s' to most nouns, and '-es' to words ending in x, ch, sh, or s.
rule.zh: 大多数名词加 '-s'，以 x, ch, sh, s 结尾的词加 '-es'。

questions.q: I have two ___ in my bag.
She sees three colorful ___.
There are four wooden ___.
He washes the glass ___ after dinner.
Look at the red ___ on the tree.
The yellow school ___ are fast.
Two small ___ ran across the room.

desc.en: Learn when to use am, is, and are.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 am, is, 和 are。

rule.en: Use 'am' with I, 'is' with He/She/It (singular), and 'are' with You/We/They (plural).
rule.zh: I 用 am，单数（He/She/It）用 is，复数（You/We/They）用 are。

questions.q: I ___ a student.
She ___ my teacher.
They ___ happy today.
The cat ___ sleeping on the mat.
We ___ ready for the game.
You ___ very kind.
My dog and cat ___ good friends.

desc.en: Use 'this' for near items and 'that' for far items.
desc.zh: 用 'this' 表示近处，'that' 表示远处。

rule.en: Use 'this' when holding or near an object, and 'that' when pointing to something far.
rule.zh: 拿着或靠近物体时用 'this'，指向远处物体时用 'that'。

questions.q: ___ is my pen in my hand.
Look at ___ bird high up in the tree!
___ hat on my head is warm.
Do you see ___ airplane far away in the sky?
___ is my favorite toy right here.
___ star over there is very bright.
I love ___ book I am reading now.

title.en: Possessive Adjectives: My, Your, His, Her
title.zh: 物主代词：My, Your, His, Her

desc.en: Show who owns something.
desc.zh: 表示物品所属关系。

rule.en: Use my (belonging to me), your (belonging to you), his (belonging to a boy), and her (belonging to a girl).
rule.zh: my（我的），your（你的），his（他的），her（她的）。

questions.q: I have a bag. This is ___ bag.
John has a bicycle. That is ___ bicycle.
Mary loves ___ new shoes.
What is ___ name? My name is Alex.
The boy put on ___ coat.
The girl brushed ___ hair.
We love ___ classroom.

title.zh: 一般现在时：Like 与 Likes

desc.en: Add -s for He, She, and It.
desc.zh: 主语为 He, She, It 时动词加 -s。

rule.en: Use 'like' with I/You/We/They, and 'likes' with He/She/It.
rule.zh: I/You/We/They 用 like，He/She/It 用 likes。

questions.q: I ___ to eat apples.
She ___ to play piano.
He ___ milk every morning.
They ___ to swim in the pool.
My dog ___ to run fast.
We ___ reading storybooks.
The kitten ___ warm sunshine.

title.zh: 一般现在时：Have 与 Has

desc.en: Learn when to use have and has.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 have 和 has。

rule.en: Use 'have' with I/You/We/They, and 'has' with He/She/It.
rule.zh: I/You/We/They 用 have，He/She/It 用 has。

questions.q: I ___ a red ball.
She ___ a cute cat.
He ___ a new toy car.
We ___ two blue pencils.
They ___ a big garden.
The elephant ___ long ears.
You ___ a nice smile.

desc.en: Adjectives describe nouns and go before them.
desc.zh: 形容词修饰名词，放在名词前面。

rule.en: Place size and color adjectives before the noun (a big red house).
rule.zh: 将大小和颜色形容词放在名词前（如 a big red house）。

questions.q: I see a ___ balloon.
The elephant is a ___ animal.
She bought a ___ dress.
He has a ___ dog.
Look at the ___ sky.
They live in a ___ house.
We ate a ___ apple.

desc.en: Action verbs show what a subject does.
desc.zh: 动作动词说明主语做出的行为。

rule.en: Action verbs describe physical or mental actions (run, jump, sleep, read).
rule.zh: 动作动词描述身体或心理动作（如 run, jump, sleep, read）。

questions.q: Birds ___ in the sky.
Fish ___ in the water.
Rabbits ___ high.
Children ___ games in the park.
I ___ books every night.
Cats ___ on soft cushions.
We ___ water when we are thirsty.

desc.en: Learn prepositions of place.
desc.zh: 学习表示位置的介词。

rule.en: Use 'in' for inside, 'on' for on top of a surface, and 'under' for below.
rule.zh: 'in' 表示在……里面，'on' 表示在表面上，'under' 表示在下面。

questions.q: The book is ___ the table.
The apple is ___ the basket.
The cat is sleeping ___ the bed.
Pencils are ___ the pencil case.
The picture hangs ___ the wall.
The dog is resting ___ the shade of the tree.
Put your shoes ___ the cabinet.

desc.en: Ask questions with What, Who, and Where.
desc.zh: 用 What, Who, Where 提问。

rule.en: Use 'What' for things, 'Who' for people, and 'Where' for places.
rule.zh: 'What' 询问事物，'Who' 询问人物，'Where' 询问地点。

questions.q: ___ is your name?
___ is that boy?
___ is my hat?
___ are you eating?
___ is your English teacher?
___ do you live?
___ is in your schoolbag?

desc.en: Express ability or inability.
desc.zh: 表达能力或不能。

rule.en: Use 'can' for things you are able to do, and 'cannot' / 'can't' for things you are unable to do.
rule.zh: 'can' 表示能够，'cannot / can't' 表示不能。

questions.q: Birds ___ fly in the sky.
Fish ___ walk on land.
I ___ speak English.
Elephants ___ jump very high.
She ___ play the guitar well.
Babies ___ drive cars.
You ___ do it if you try hard!

desc.en: Start with a capital letter and end with . or ?
desc.zh: 首字母大写，句末加句号或问号。

rule.en: Every sentence starts with a capital letter. Statements end with a period (.) and questions end with a question mark (?).
rule.zh: 每句话首字母大写。陈述句加句号（.），问句加问号（?）。

questions.q: ___ dog is very big.
___ is your name?
___ name is Sam.
How old are you ___
This is a red apple ___
___ is a sunny day.
What is your favorite color ___

desc.en: Give simple instructions and orders.
desc.zh: 给出简短指令和要求。

rule.en: Imperative sentences begin with a base verb to tell someone what to do.
rule.zh: 祈使句以动词原形开头，指示他人做出动作。

questions.q: ___ your book to page 10.
___ down on your chair, please.
___ to the teacher carefully.
___ make noise in the library.
___ up your hands if you know the answer.
___ run in the hallway.
___ your name at the top of the paper.

text.en: Our school has a sunny garden behind the main building. Students plant bright red tomatoes and sweet carrots in tidy rows. Everyone waters the plants after lunch every single day.
text.zh: 我们学校在主楼后面有一个阳光明媚的花园。学生们在整齐的行排里种上鲜红的西红柿和甜甜的胡萝卜。大家每天午饭后都会给植物浇水。

questions.q: Where is the school garden located?
What vegetables do students plant?
When do students water the plants?

text.en: Leo and his younger sister go to the central park on Saturday. They feed fresh bread crumbs to ducks swimming in the pond. Afterward they ride their colorful bicycles along the paved path.
text.zh: 利奥和妹妹星期六去中央公园。他们给在池塘里游泳的鸭子喂新鲜的面包屑。之后，他们沿着铺好的小路骑着色彩斑斓的自行车。

questions.q: When do Leo and his sister visit the park?
What do they feed to the ducks?
What activity do they do after feeding the ducks?

text.en: Emma adopted a cute brown puppy from the animal shelter. The friendly puppy loves to chase tennis balls in the green yard. Emma brushes its soft fur every evening before dinner.
text.zh: 艾玛从动物庇护所领养了一只可爱的小棕狗。这只友好的小狗喜欢在绿色的院子里追逐网球。艾玛每天晚饭前都会为它梳理柔软的毛发。

questions.q: Where did Emma adopt her puppy?
What toy does the puppy love to chase?
When does Emma brush the puppy's fur?

text.en: Grandma bakes a warm apple pie for the family Sunday dinner. She slices crisp red apples and sprinkles sweet cinnamon sugar on top. The delicious pie smells wonderful as it bakes in the oven.
text.zh: 奶奶为家里的星期日晚餐烘焙了一个热气腾腾的苹果派。她把脆红的苹果切成片，并在上面洒上甜甜的肉桂糖。美味的苹果派在烤箱里烘烤时散发出诱人的香味。

questions.q: What does Grandma bake for Sunday dinner?
What spice does Grandma sprinkle on top?
How does the pie smell while baking?

text.en: The town library has thousands of interesting children's books. Readers can sit in cozy armchairs to read quiet stories. Friendly librarians help students find books for school projects.
text.zh: 镇上的图书馆有数千本有趣的童书。读者可以坐在舒适的单人沙发上安静地读故事。友善的图书管理员帮助学生寻找学校课题所需的书籍。

questions.q: How many children's books are in the library?
Where can readers sit in the library?
Who helps students find books?

text.en: Gentle spring rain falls quietly over the green farm fields. Fresh rainwater helps young wheat plants grow tall and strong. Rainbows appear in the bright blue sky when the rain stops.
text.zh: 柔和的春雨静静地洒在绿色的农田里。新鲜的雨水帮助幼小的小麦生长得高大健壮。雨止时，鲜艳的彩虹出现在蔚蓝的天空中。

questions.q: Where does gentle spring rain fall?
What plants grow tall from the rainwater?
What appears in the sky after the rain stops?

text.en: Jack and his grandfather build a small wooden birdhouse together. They paint the outside bright yellow and hang it high on a tree branch. Soon a pair of bluebirds build a nest inside.
text.zh: 杰克和爷爷一起建造了一个小木鸟窝。他们把外面涂成鲜黄色，挂在高高的树枝上。很快，一对蓝知更鸟在里面筑起了巢。

questions.q: Who builds the wooden birdhouse with Jack?
What color do they paint the birdhouse?
Which birds build a nest inside?

text.en: Our family goes camping near a clear mountain stream in July. We sleep in a big blue tent under tall pine trees. At night we watch bright fireflies dance near the campfire.
text.zh: 我们一家人在七月份去一座清澈的高山溪流附近露营。我们睡在大松树下一顶蓝色的大帐篷里。夜间，我们看着明亮的萤火虫在篝火旁跳舞。

questions.q: When does the family go camping?
Where is the camp located?
What insects dance near the campfire at night?

text.en: Mia learns to play the wooden violin during her weekly music class. Her teacher shows her how to hold the bow correctly. Mia practices her favorite song every day after school.
text.zh: 米娅在每周的音乐课上学习拉木小提琴。她的老师向她展示如何正确握弓。米娅每天放学后练习她最喜欢的歌曲。

questions.q: What instrument does Mia learn to play?
What does her teacher show her?
options: How to hold the bow correctly

questions.q: When does Mia practice her song?

text.en: The city zoo is home to many wonderful wild animals. Visitors can watch friendly pandas eat green bamboo stalks in their habitat. Guides explain how keepers take good care of all the animals.
text.zh: 城市动物园是许多美妙野生动物的家。游客们可以看到友好的大熊猫在栖息地吃绿竹子。导游解释饲养员如何精心照顾所有的动物。

questions.q: What do pandas eat in their habitat?
Who explains how keepers take care of animals?
What kind of animals live in the city zoo?

text.en: Volunteers gather at the ocean beach every Saturday morning. They pick up plastic bottles and trash to keep the shore clean. Their hard work protects ocean animals and sea birds.
text.zh: 志愿者们每个星期六早晨聚集在海洋沙滩上。他们捡起塑料瓶和垃圾，保持海岸干净。他们的辛勤工作保护了海洋动物和海鸟。

questions.q: When do volunteers gather at the beach?
What do volunteers pick up?
Who does their hard work protect?

text.en: The local fire station is always ready to respond to emergencies. Red fire engines are parked inside clean garages with tools. Brave firefighters check their gear daily to help people in need.
text.zh: 当地的消防局时刻准备应对突发状况。红色的消防车和工具停放在干净的车库里。勇敢的消防员每天检查装备，向有需要的人提供帮助。

questions.q: Where are the red fire engines parked?
How often do firefighters check their gear?
Why do firefighters check their gear?

text.en: In autumn, our family visits a big apple orchard in the countryside. We pick sweet red apples straight from leafy tree branches. We take home two large baskets full of delicious fresh fruit.
text.zh: 秋天，我们一家人去郊区的大苹果园游玩。我们直接从郁郁葱葱的树枝上采摘甜美的红苹果。我们带回家两个装满美味新鲜水果的大篮子。

questions.q: When does the family visit the apple orchard?
Where do they pick apples from?
How many baskets of fruit do they take home?

text.en: Sam attends swimming lessons at the indoor community pool. His instructor teaches him how to kick his legs and float safely. Sam earns a bright blue badge after passing his swimming test.
text.zh: 萨姆在社区室内游泳池参加游泳课程。他的教练教他如何蹬腿并安全地漂浮。萨姆在通过游泳测试后获得了一枚鲜艳的蓝色徽章。

questions.q: Where does Sam attend swimming lessons?
What does the instructor teach Sam to do?
What color badge does Sam earn after passing the test?

text.en: A honeybee colony lives in a wooden hive in the meadow. Worker bees collect sweet flower nectar during warm sunny days. They make delicious golden honey that feeds the entire bee colony.
text.zh: 一个蜜蜂群体生活在草地上的木蜂巢里。工蜂在温暖晴朗的日子里收集甜美的花蜜。它们制成美味的金黄蜂蜜，滋养整个蜂群。

questions.q: Where does the honeybee colony live?
options: In a wooden hive in the meadow

questions.q: What do worker bees collect during sunny days?
What do bees produce to feed the colony?

text.en: Students present creative projects at the annual school science fair. Ben built a model volcano that erupts red bubbly foam. Lily demonstrated how solar panels power a small toy fan. The principal awarded blue ribbons to the top three young inventors.
text.zh: 学生们在年度学校科学展览会上展示富有创意的项目。本制作了一个喷发红色泡沫的火山模型。莉莉演示了太阳能电池板如何为小玩具风扇供电。校长向前三名年轻发明家颁发了蓝色丝带。

questions.q: What event takes place at school?
What model did Ben build?
What did Lily demonstrate?
options: How solar panels power a toy fan

questions.q: What prize did top young inventors receive?

text.en: Our town celebrates the winter season with a joyful outdoor festival. Sculptors create giant ice statues of dragons and castles along Main Street. Families sip hot cocoa while enjoying festive light displays in the park. Children laugh happily as they skate around the outdoor ice rink.
text.zh: 我们小镇以欢快的户外节日庆祝冬季。雕塑家们沿着主街创作巨大的巨龙和城堡冰雕。家庭成员们一边喝着热可可，一边欣赏公园里节日的灯光秀。孩子们在户外滑冰场上高兴地滑冰，发出欢笑声。

questions.q: Where are the giant ice statues located?
What do sculptors create from ice?
What warm drink do families sip?
Where do children skate happily?

text.en: Eight unique planets orbit around our central star, the sun. Earth is the third planet from the sun and has liquid water. Mars is known as the red planet because of its iron-rich soil. Astronomers use powerful telescopes to study distant planets and moons.
text.zh: 八大独特的行星围绕着我们的中心恒星——太阳运行。地球是离太阳第三近的行星，拥有液态水。火星因其富含铁的土壤而被誉为红星。天文学家使用强大的望远镜来研究遥远的行星和卫星。

questions.q: How many planets orbit around the sun?
Which planet is third from the sun?
Why is Mars known as the red planet?
What tool do astronomers use to study planets?

text.en: Separating recyclable household waste helps protect our environment. Plastic bottles, aluminum cans, and paper are placed in yellow bins. Sanitation trucks collect these materials to be processed into new goods. Recycling conserves natural resources and reduces landfill pollution.
text.zh: 分类回收生活垃圾有助于保护我们的环境。塑料瓶、铝罐和废纸被放进黄色回收桶。环卫卡车收集这些材料并将其加工成新产品。垃圾回收能节约自然资源，减少垃圾填埋污染。

questions.q: What color bins are used for recyclable items?
Which items are placed in the recycling bins?
What collects the recyclable materials?
What benefit does recycling provide?

text.en: Dan and his father hike up the forest trail on a clear morning. They spot wild deer grazing quietly among tall pine trees. At the mountain summit, they enjoy a breathtaking view of the valley below. They eat a packed lunch before heading safely back down.
text.zh: 丹和爸爸在一个晴朗的早晨沿着森林步道徒步登山。他们发现野生鹿在高大的松树丛中安静地吃草。在山顶，他们欣赏着下方山谷令人屏息的景色。在安全下山前，他们吃了野餐便当。

questions.q: Who hikes up the mountain trail with Dan?
What wild animals do they spot in the pine trees?
Where do they enjoy a view of the valley?
What do they eat before heading down?

text.en: A butterfly begins its life cycle as a tiny egg on a leaf. The egg hatches into a hungry caterpillar that eats green leaves daily. Later the caterpillar wraps itself inside a protective chrysalis shell. Finally a beautiful winged butterfly emerges and flies away into the sun.
text.zh: 蝴蝶作为树叶上的一粒微小虫卵开启生命的旅程。虫卵孵化成一条饥饿的毛毛虫，每天吃绿叶。之后，毛毛虫把自己包裹在保护性的蛹壳里。最终，一只美丽的羽翼蝴蝶破蛹而出，飞向阳光。

questions.q: How does a butterfly begin its life?
options: As a tiny egg on a leaf

questions.q: What does the hatched caterpillar eat daily?
What protective shell does the caterpillar wrap itself inside?
What emerges from the chrysalis?

text.en: Female sea turtles travel thousands of miles across ocean waters. They return to the exact sandy beach where they were born to lay eggs. Mother turtles dig deep holes in the warm sand for their nests. Months later tiny hatchlings scramble safely into the ocean waves.
text.zh: 雌性海龟越过千山万水在海洋中旅行。它们回到自己出生的那个沙滩产卵。海龟妈妈在温暖的沙子里挖深坑作为巢穴。数月后，微小的幼龟安全地爬入海浪中。

questions.q: Where do mother sea turtles return to lay eggs?
options: The sandy beach where they were born

questions.q: Where do mother turtles dig holes for their nests?
How far do sea turtles travel across ocean waters?
Where do hatchlings scramble after emerging?

text.en: Wind is a clean renewable source of energy that never runs out. Giant wind turbines stand on windy hills to catch strong air currents. Rotating turbine blades turn generators to produce clean electricity for homes. Using wind power protects our planet from harmful air pollution.
text.zh: 风是一种永不枯竭的清洁可再生能源。巨型风力发电机立在风大的丘陵上，捕捉强劲的气流。旋转的叶片带动发电机为家庭生产清洁的电力。使用风能可以保护我们的地球免受有害的空气污染。

questions.q: What kind of energy source is wind?
Where do giant wind turbines stand?
What do rotating turbine blades turn to generate power?
What environmental benefit does wind power offer?

text.en: The Great Wall of China is a famous historic structure built long ago. Soldiers built stone watchtowers along steep mountain ridges to guard borders. Signal smoke was burned from towers to send urgent warning messages. Today millions of global visitors admire this magnificent historic monument.
text.zh: 中国长城是久远以前建造的著名历史建筑。士兵们沿着陡峭的山脊修建了石砌烽火台来守卫边疆。人们从烽火台上燃起狼烟来发送紧急预警信号。如今，数以百万计的全球游客对这座宏伟的历史遗迹叹为观止。

questions.q: Where were stone watchtowers built?
Why did soldiers burn signal smoke from watchtowers?
What is the Great Wall recognized as today?
Who built the stone watchtowers long ago?

text.en: Robotic space rovers travel across the red surface of planet Mars. These advanced rovers take clear photos and drill rock samples for scientists. Scientists search for clues of ancient water lakes and microscopic life. Space exploration helps humans understand the origins of neighboring planets.
text.zh: 机器人太空巡视器在火星这颗行星的红色表面上穿行。这些先进的巡视器拍摄清晰照片，并为科学家钻取岩石样本。科学家寻找古老水域湖泊和微观生命的线索。太空探索帮助人类了解邻近行星的起源。

questions.q: Where do robotic space rovers travel?
options: Across the red surface of Mars

questions.q: What samples do rovers drill for scientists?
What clues do scientists search for on Mars?
How does space exploration help humans?

text.en: The Amazon rainforest is the largest tropical rainforest on planet Earth. Millions of rare plant species, colorful birds, and unique animals live here. Dense tree canopies absorb carbon dioxide and release fresh oxygen into the air. Protecting the rainforest is vital for maintaining our global climate balance.
text.zh: 亚马逊热带雨林是地球上最大的热带雨林。数以百万计的稀有植物物种、色彩斑斓的鸟类和独特的动物生活在这里。茂密的树冠吸收二氧化碳，并将新鲜的氧气释放到空气中。保护雨林对于维持全球气候平衡至关重要。

questions.q: Which is the largest tropical rainforest on Earth?
What do dense tree canopies absorb from the air?
What do dense tree canopies release into the air?
Why is protecting the Amazon rainforest vital?

text.en: Classes tour the natural history museum on Thursday afternoon. Guide leaders show students real dinosaur fossil bones and ancient artifacts. Interactive exhibits let children learn how early humans crafted stone tools. Students take notes in notebooks for their weekly history report.
text.zh: 班级于星期四下午参观自然历史博物馆。讲解员向学生展示真实的恐龙化石骨骼和古代遗迹。互动展品让孩子们了解早期人类如何制作石器工具。学生们在笔记本上记录笔记，为每周的历史报告作准备。

questions.q: Where do students tour on Thursday afternoon?
What real items do guide leaders show to students?
What do interactive exhibits teach children about early humans?
options: How early humans crafted stone tools

questions.q: Why do students take notes during the tour?

text.en: Eating a balanced meal gives children energy to grow and study well. Fresh vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and clean protein build strong bodies. Drinking pure water instead of sugary sodas prevents tooth decay and fatigue. Choosing healthy snacks keeps our minds sharp throughout the day.
text.zh: 吃平衡的膳食赋予孩子生长和良好学习的能量。新鲜蔬菜、水果、全谷物和优质蛋白质强健身体。喝纯净水而不是含糖汽水能防止蛀牙和疲劳。选择健康零食能让我们的思维整天保持敏捷。

questions.q: What does a balanced meal provide for children?
options: Energy to grow and study well

questions.q: Which foods help build strong bodies?
What health problem does drinking pure water help prevent?
What benefit comes from choosing healthy snacks?

text.en: Coral reefs are vibrant underwater structures formed by tiny marine polyps. Thousands of colorful fish species hide among delicate coral branches for shelter. Clean clear ocean water allows sunlight to nourish living reef ecosystems. Protecting marine habitats prevents coral bleaching and preserves sea life.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是由微小的海洋虫体形成的充满生机的水下建筑。成千上万彩色的鱼类藏身于纤细的珊瑚枝桠间寻求庇护。干净清澈的海水让阳光滋养活体珊瑚礁生态系统。保护海洋栖息地可以防止珊瑚白化，保护海洋生物。

questions.q: What tiny creatures form coral reefs?
Why do colorful fish hide among coral branches?
What allows sunlight to nourish the living reef ecosystem?
What does protecting marine habitats prevent?

text.en: Orville and Wilbur Wright built the first motorized airplane in 1903. Their historic flight over North Carolina dunes lasted just twelve seconds. That short successful flight changed global transportation and travel forever. Today passenger jets carry millions of travelers safely across oceans.
text.zh: 奥维尔和维尔伯·莱特于1903年建造了第一架动力飞机。他们跨越北卡罗来纳州沙丘的历史性飞行仅持续了十二秒。那次简短而成功的飞行永远改变了全球交通和旅行。如今，客运喷气式飞机安全地载着数以百万计的旅客飞越重洋。

questions.q: Who built the first motorized airplane in 1903?
How long did the first historic flight last?
Where did the first flight take place?
How did that flight impact world travel?

text.en: Honeybees live together in organized colonies consisting of thousands of worker bees. A single queen bee lays hundreds of eggs daily to increase the colony population. Worker bees forage for sweet flower nectar and transfer pollen between blooming plants. This essential pollination process allows crops, flowers, and fruit trees to thrive.
text.zh: 蜜蜂共同生活在由数千只工蜂组成的有组织的群体中。一只蜂后每天产几百个卵，增加种群数量。工蜂搜寻甜美的花蜜，并在盛开的植物之间传播花粉。这种至关重要的授粉过程使农作物、花卉和果树茁壮成长。

questions.q: How do honeybees live?
What is the primary role of the queen bee?
What do worker bees transfer between plants?
Why is pollination important?
options: Allows crops and fruits to thrive

questions.q: What do worker bees forage for?

text.en: The Great Barrier Reef off Australia is the world's largest living coral reef ecosystem. Thousands of marine species including sea turtles, reef sharks, and clownfish inhabit its clear waters. Coral polyps live together with microscopic algae that produce energy through sunlight. Environmental conservation efforts protect this natural wonder from climate warming threats.
text.zh: 澳大利亚沿海的大堡礁是世界上最大的活珊瑚礁生态系统。包括海龟、礁鲨和小丑鱼在内的数千种海洋物种栖息在其清澈的水域中。珊瑚虫与通过阳光产生能量的微观藻类生活在一起。环境保护的努力保护这一自然奇观免受气候变暖的威胁。

questions.q: Where is the Great Barrier Reef located?
What live together with coral polyps?
How do the algae produce energy?
Which species inhabit the reef waters?
What threat do conservation efforts protect the reef against?

text.en: Movable type printing was pioneered by Bi Sheng in eleventh-century Song Dynasty China. He carved individual Chinese characters onto small durable clay blocks baked in ovens. Later in Europe Johannes Gutenberg developed the mechanical metal printing press. This groundbreaking invention allowed books to be mass-produced, spreading literacy worldwide.
text.zh: 活字印刷术由中国宋朝的毕昇在十一世纪开创。他将单个汉字刻在经过烤箱烘烤的小型耐用黏土块上。后来在欧洲，约翰内斯·谷登堡发明了机械金属印刷机。这一突破性的发明使书籍得以大规模生产，在世界范围内传播了读写能力。

questions.q: Who pioneered movable type printing in 11th century China?
What material did Bi Sheng use for his individual character blocks?
Who developed the mechanical metal printing press in Europe?
What impact did the printing press have globally?
During which Chinese dynasty was movable type invented?

text.en: The deep ocean floor lies in complete darkness thousands of meters below sea level. Many deep-sea creatures produce their own cold light to attract prey or scare predators. The anglerfish uses a glowing lure above its head to catch small fish in the dark. Scientists use robotic submersibles equipped with bright lights to explore this mysterious habitat.
text.zh: 深海海底位于海平面以下数千米的全黑环境中。许多深海生物产生自己的冷光来吸引猎物或吓退捕食者。琵琶鱼使用头顶上方发光的诱饵在黑暗中捕获小鱼。科学家们使用配备明亮灯光的机器人潜水器来探索这个神秘的栖息地。

questions.q: What conditions exist on the deep ocean floor?
options: Complete darkness thousands of meters below sea level

questions.q: Why do deep-sea creatures produce their own cold light?
options: To attract prey or scare predators

questions.q: What does the anglerfish use to catch small fish in the dark?
options: A glowing lure above its head

questions.q: What equipment do scientists use to explore the deep ocean?
How is light produced by deep-sea creatures described?

text.en: Solar energy captures clean light rays from the sun to generate electric power. Dark silicon panels installed on rooftops absorb sunlight energy throughout sunny days. Special devices called inverters convert this energy into electricity for household appliances. Using solar power reduces electricity costs and protects our global atmosphere.
text.zh: 太阳能吸收来自太阳的清洁光线来发电。安装在屋顶上的黑色硅板在晴朗的日子里吸收阳光能。被称为逆变器的特殊设备将这种能量转换为供家用电器使用的电力。使用太阳能可以降低用电成本，保护我们的全球大气。

questions.q: What does solar energy capture to generate electric power?
options: Clean light rays from the sun

questions.q: Where are dark silicon panels installed to absorb sunlight?
What special devices convert solar energy into household electricity?
What environmental benefit does solar power provide?
options: Reduces electricity costs and protects atmosphere

questions.q: What material are the solar panels made of?

text.en: The modern steam engine was improved by Scottish engineer James Watt in the 1770s. Steam engines burned coal to heat water into high-pressure steam that drove heavy pistons. This invention powered early railway locomotives, steamships, and factory machinery worldwide. The steam engine triggered the Industrial Revolution, changing human manufacturing forever.
text.zh: 苏格兰工程师詹姆斯·瓦特在18世纪70年代改进了现代蒸汽机。蒸汽机燃烧煤炭将水加热成高压蒸汽，从而驱动沉重的活塞。这项发明为早期的铁路火车头、轮船和工厂机械提供了动力。蒸汽机引发了工业革命，永远改变了人类的制造业。

questions.q: Who improved the modern steam engine in the 1770s?
How did steam engines generate power?
options: Burned coal to heat water into steam driving pistons

questions.q: Which transportation vehicles were powered by steam engines?
What historic era was triggered by the steam engine?
What nationality was engineer James Watt?

text.en: Green plants make their own food through a natural process called photosynthesis. Plant roots absorb water and essential minerals from the moist soil below. Green leaves absorb carbon dioxide gas and capture energy from incoming sunlight. This vital process converts water and gas into food while releasing oxygen for humans to breathe.
text.zh: 绿色植物通过一种被称为光合作用的自然过程制造自己的食物。植物根部从下方潮湿的土壤中吸收水和必需的矿物质。绿叶吸收二氧化碳气体并从传入的阳光中捕捉能量。这一至关重要的过程将水和气体转化为食物，同时释放供人类呼吸的氧气。

questions.q: What natural process do green plants use to make food?
What do plant roots absorb from the soil?
What gas do green leaves absorb from the air?
What beneficial gas is released during photosynthesis?
Where does the energy for photosynthesis come from?

text.en: The ancient pyramids of Egypt were constructed thousands of years ago as royal tombs. Skilled workers moved millions of heavy limestone blocks across the desert sand to build them. The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest man-made structure in the world for centuries. Today historic historians study these architectural marvels to understand ancient engineering techniques.
text.zh: 古埃及的金字塔建于几千年前，是法老的陵墓。技艺精湛的工人们将数以百万计的重型石灰石块推过沙漠，建造了它们。吉萨大金字塔在几个世纪里都是世界上最高的人造建筑。今天，历史学家们研究这些建筑奇迹，以了解古代的工程技术。

questions.q: Why were ancient pyramids constructed in Egypt?
What material was used to build the pyramids?
Which pyramid was the tallest man-made structure for centuries?
Who moved the heavy blocks across the desert?
Why do historians continue studying the pyramids today?

text.en: The rainforest canopy forms a thick green roof high above the forest floor. Over eighty percent of all tropical forest wildlife lives within this sunlit upper layer. Toucans, monkeys, and tree frogs find abundant food and safe shelter in dense leaves. Protecting tree canopies ensures that rare endangered animals remain protected from extinction.
text.zh: 雨林树冠层在森林地面高处形成了一座厚厚的绿色屋顶。超过百分之八十的热带森林野生动物生活在这个阳光明媚的上层。巨嘴鸟、猴子和树蛙在茂密的树叶中找到了丰富的食物和安全庇护所。保护树冠能确保稀有濒危动物免于灭绝。

questions.q: What forms a thick green roof above the rainforest floor?
What percentage of rainforest wildlife lives in the canopy layer?
Which animals find food and shelter in dense canopy leaves?
Why is protecting rainforest tree canopies important?
options: Ensures rare animals are protected from extinction

questions.q: How is the upper canopy layer described in terms of light?

text.en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the first practical telephone in 1876. He transmitted speech electrical signals over copper wires between separate rooms. This revolutionary device transformed long-distance communication across cities and countries. Today modern smartphones connect billions of people instantly around the globe.
text.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔于1876年发明了第一台实用电话。他通过铜线在不同的房间之间传输语音电信号。这项革命性的设备改变了城市和国家之间的长途通信。如今，现代智能手机在全球瞬间连接着几十亿人。

questions.q: Who invented the first practical telephone in 1876?
How did the early telephone transmit voice messages?
options: Transmitted speech electrical signals over copper wires

questions.q: What form of human activity was transformed by the telephone?
What modern device connects billions of people today?
In what year was the first telephone invented?

text.en: Marine biologists study ocean ecosystems to protect endangered sea animals. Marine plastic pollution harms dolphins, sea turtles, and seabirds worldwide. Community beach cleanup drives remove thousands of pounds of plastic waste annually. Reducing plastic usage preserves ocean food chains and keeps waters clean.
text.zh: 海洋生物学家研究海洋生态系统，以保护濒危海洋动物。海洋塑料污染损害着全球的海豚、海龟和海鸟。社区沙滩清理运动每年清除数千磅的塑料垃圾。减少塑料的使用可以保护海洋食物链，保持水质清洁。

questions.q: Who studies ocean ecosystems to protect endangered sea life?
What pollution harms sea turtles, dolphins, and seabirds?
What community action removes thousands of pounds of plastic waste?
What is preserved by reducing plastic usage?
How often are cleanup drives organized?

text.en: The Grand Canyon in Arizona was carved over millions of years by the Colorado River. Layered red rock walls expose ancient geological history stretching back centuries. Rare wildlife including bighorn sheep and California condors inhabit the canyon cliffs. Millions of international tourists visit national park lookouts to view this natural masterpiece.
text.zh: 亚利桑那州的科罗拉多大峡谷是科罗拉多河经历数百万年切割而成的。分层的红岩壁展现了回溯几个世纪的古代地质历史。包括大角羊和加州兀鹰在内的稀有野生动物栖息在峡谷悬崖上。数以百万计的国际游客游览国家公园观景台，观赏这一自然杰作。

questions.q: What river carved the Grand Canyon over millions of years?
In which US state is the Grand Canyon located?
What do layered red rock walls expose?
Which rare animals inhabit the canyon cliffs?
What attracts millions of international tourists to the canyon?
options: National park lookouts viewing natural masterpiece

text.en: American inventor Thomas Edison developed the practical electric light bulb in 1879. He tested thousands of different carbon filaments inside vacuum glass bulbs. His successful invention replaced dim candles and dangerous gas lamps in houses. Electric lighting safe and bright transformed night work, education, and city life.
text.zh: 美国发明家托马斯·爱迪生于1879年研制出实用的电灯泡。他在真空玻璃灯泡内测试了数千种不同的碳灯丝。他的成功发明取代了房屋里昏暗的蜡烛和危险的煤气灯。安全明亮的电照明改变了夜间工作、教育和城市生活。

questions.q: Who developed the practical electric light bulb in 1879?
What component did Edison test thousands of times inside glass bulbs?
What older lighting sources did electric bulbs replace?
options: Dim candles and dangerous gas lamps

questions.q: How did electric lighting impact human society?
options: Transformed night work, education, and city life

questions.q: In what year was the practical electric light bulb invented?

text.en: Many bird species undertake long-distance seasonal migrations every spring and autumn. Flocks of geese fly together in V-shaped formations to conserve energy during flight. Birds navigate using landmarks, Earth's magnetic field, and position of the sun. Protecting stopover wetland habitats provides essential food and rest along their flight paths.
text.zh: 许多鸟类在每年春秋两季都会进行长途的季节性迁徙。大雁群以V字队形一起飞翔，以在飞行中节省精力。鸟类利用地标、地球磁场和太阳的位置进行导航。保护中途停留的湿地栖息地为它们的飞行路径提供必需的食物和休息。

questions.q: When do many bird species undertake seasonal migrations?
Why do flocks of geese fly in V-shaped formations?
What cues do birds use to navigate during flight?
options: Landmarks, magnetic field, and sun position

questions.q: Why is protecting stopover wetland habitats crucial?
options: Provides essential food and rest along flight paths

questions.q: What type of environment serves as crucial stopovers for migrating birds?

text.en: Honeybees perform intricate dances to communicate food locations to hive mates. A scout bee returns to the hive and dances in circular patterns showing distance and direction. Other worker bees follow these clear signals to locate nectar-rich flower fields miles away. Teamwork allows bee colonies to efficiently gather honey reserves for winter survival.
text.zh: 蜜蜂跳着复杂的舞蹈，向巢友传递食物的位置信息。一只侦察蜂回到蜂巢，以圆形图案跳舞，展示距离和方向。其他工蜂遵循这些清晰的信号，找到数英里外富含花蜜的花田。团队合作使蜂群能够高效地收集冬季生存所需的蜂蜜储备。

questions.q: How do honeybees communicate food locations to hive mates?
What information does a scout bee's dance convey?
Who follows the scout bee's dance signals?
What benefit does teamwork provide for the bee colony?
options: Efficiently gathers honey reserves for winter

questions.q: Where do worker bees locate nectar after following signals?

text.en: The ancient Silk Road was a vast network of trade routes connecting Asia with Europe. Traders transported valuable goods including Chinese silk, porcelain, spices, and tea across desert sands. Caravan travelers braved harsh weather, rugged mountains, and long distances on camels. Along with goods, cultural ideas, inventions, and religions spread rapidly between civilizations. Today historians study the Silk Road as an early foundation of global trade.
text.zh: 古代丝绸之路是连接亚洲与欧洲的漫大贸易路线网络。商人横穿沙漠，运送包括中国丝绸、瓷器、香料和茶叶在内的贵重商品。商队旅人骑着骆驼顶着严酷的天气、崎岖的山脉和遥远的距离前行。除了商品，文化思想、发明和宗教也在文明之间迅速传播。今天，历史学家将丝绸之路视为全球早期贸易的基础来研究。

questions.q: What was the ancient Silk Road?
options: A vast network of trade routes connecting Asia with Europe

questions.q: Which valuable goods were transported along the Silk Road?
options: Chinese silk, porcelain, spices, and tea

questions.q: What animal did caravan travelers rely on across desert sands?
Besides physical goods, what else spread along the trade routes?
How do historians view the Silk Road today?
options: As an early foundation of global trade

questions.q: What natural obstacles did caravan travelers brave?
options: Harsh weather, mountains, and long distances

text.en: Renewable energy harnesses natural forces that replenish continuously over time. Solar panels absorb sunlight, wind turbines catch air currents, and hydroelectric dams utilize water flow. Unlike fossil fuels, clean energy sources produce zero harmful greenhouse gas emissions. Transitioning to green power helps combat global climate change and reduces environmental pollution. Communities worldwide are installing clean energy systems to build a sustainable future.
text.zh: 可再生能源利用随时间推移而不断补充的自然力量。太阳能电池板吸收阳光，风力发电机捕捉气流，水电站大坝利用水流。与化石燃料不同，清洁能源产生零有害温室气体排放。向绿色能源转型有助于应对全球气候变化，减少环境污染。世界各地的社区正在安装清洁能源系统，以建设可持续的未来。

questions.q: What defines renewable energy?
options: Harnesses natural forces that replenish continuously

questions.q: Which technologies harness clean natural forces?
options: Solar panels, wind turbines, and hydroelectric dams

questions.q: What key environmental advantage does clean energy have over fossil fuels?
options: Produces zero harmful greenhouse gas emissions

questions.q: How does transitioning to green power benefit Earth?
options: Combats climate change and reduces pollution

questions.q: Why are communities installing clean energy systems worldwide?
What natural force does a hydroelectric dam utilize?

text.en: Orbiting space telescopes capture high-resolution images of distant galaxies millions of light-years away. Free from Earth's atmospheric distortion, these observatories observe faint starlight with extreme clarity. Astronomers discover new exoplanets, giant gas clouds, and exploding supernova stars in deep space. Data collected helps scientists calculate the age, expansion rate, and structure of our universe. Future space missions will deploy even larger telescopes to search for habitable worlds.
text.zh: 轨道太空望远镜拍摄数百万光年外遥远星系的高分辨率图像。摆脱了地球大气的扭曲，这些天文台能以极高的清晰度观测微弱的星光。天文学家在深空中发现了新的外星行星、巨型气体云和爆发的超新星。收集的数据帮助科学家计算出我们宇宙的年龄、膨胀率和结构。未来的太空任务将部署更大的望远镜来寻找适居世界。

questions.q: Where do orbiting space telescopes capture images of distant galaxies?
options: In space, millions of light-years away

questions.q: Why can space telescopes observe faint starlight with extreme clarity?
options: Because they are closer to stars

questions.q: What deep-space phenomena do astronomers discover?
options: Exoplanets, gas clouds, and supernova stars

questions.q: How does collected space data assist scientists?
options: Calculates age, expansion rate, and structure of universe

questions.q: What will future space missions deploy to search for habitable worlds?
What distance scale is measured for distant galaxies?

text.en: The Amazon Basin contains the largest tropical rainforest and river system in the world. It provides a unique habitat for one-tenth of all known animal and plant species on Earth. Dense vegetation acts as a giant carbon sink, absorbing vast amounts of carbon dioxide daily. Indigenous communities have lived in harmony with the rainforest environment for centuries. Conservation groups work tirelessly to prevent deforestation and protect global biodiversity.
text.zh: 亚马逊河流域拥有世界上最大的热带雨林和水系。它为地球上十分之一的已知动植物物种提供了独特的栖息地。茂密的植被作为一个巨大的碳汇，每天吸收大量的二氧化碳。土著社区几个世纪以来一直与雨林环境和谐相处。保护团体不懈努力，防止森林砍伐，保护全球生物多样性。

questions.q: What feature makes the Amazon Basin famous?
options: Largest tropical rainforest and river system

questions.q: What fraction of Earth's known species live in the Amazon?
How does Amazon vegetation function regarding carbon dioxide?
options: Acts as a giant carbon sink absorbing vast amounts

questions.q: How long have indigenous communities lived in harmony with the rainforest?
What goal do conservation groups work tirelessly to achieve?
What type of climate ecosystem is the Amazon?

text.en: A honeybee colony operates with astonishing precision and division of labor. The queen bee lays thousands of eggs inside wax honeycomb cells constructed by workers. Nurse bees feed royal jelly to developing larvae until they transform into pupae. Young worker bees clean cells, build comb, and guard the entrance against predators. Older foragers venture outside to harvest nectar and pollinate blooming crops.
text.zh: 一个蜜蜂群体以惊人的精确度和分工运转。蜂后在工蜂建造的蜡质蜂巢格里产下数千个卵。保育蜂向发育中的幼虫喂食蜂王浆，直到它们转化为蛹。年轻工蜂清理巢房、建造蜂巢，并守卫入口抵抗捕食者。较年长的前往户外采蜜的蜂则冒险到室外采蜜并为盛开的农作物授粉。

questions.q: How does a honeybee colony operate?
options: With precision and division of labor

questions.q: Where does the queen bee lay thousands of eggs?
What food do nurse bees feed to developing larvae?
What duties do young worker bees perform inside the hive?
options: Clean cells, build comb, and guard entrance

questions.q: What task is assigned to older foraging bees?
options: Harvest nectar and pollinate crops outside

questions.q: Into what stage do larvae transform before becoming adult bees?

text.en: Volcanoes form where molten rock called magma rises through cracks in Earth's crust. When pressure builds beneath the surface, a sudden volcanic eruption can occur. Eruptions release glowing hot lava flows, volcanic ash clouds, and steam into the air. Over time, cooled lava hardens into nutrient-rich volcanic rock that forms new land. Geologists monitor volcanic activity with seismic sensors to give early safety warnings.
text.zh: 火山形成于被称为岩浆的熔融岩石通过地壳裂缝上升的地方。当地下压力积聚时，可能会发生突然的火山喷发。喷发向空中释放出灼热的岩浆流、火山灰云和蒸汽。随着时间的推移，冷却的岩浆硬化成富含养分的火山岩，形成新的陆地。地质学家用地震传感器监测火山活动，以给出早期安全预警。

questions.q: Where do volcanoes form on Earth?
options: Where molten magma rises through cracks in crust

questions.q: What causes a volcanic eruption to occur?
What materials are released during a volcanic eruption?
options: Hot lava flows, ash clouds, and steam

questions.q: What happens when cooled lava hardens over time?
options: Hardens into nutrient-rich rock forming new land

questions.q: How do geologists monitor volcanic activity for safety warnings?
What is molten rock called while still beneath Earth's surface?

text.en: Coral reefs provide critical marine sanctuaries that protect coastal shores from wave erosion. Polyps construct massive limestone skeletons that support thousands of diverse sea species. Algae living inside coral polyps absorb sunlight to provide essential food nutrients. Rising sea temperatures cause coral stress and bleaching, endangering marine ecosystems. Marine reserves restrict fishing and pollution to preserve these vital living habitats.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁提供了至关重要的海洋保护区，保护海岸线免受海浪侵蚀。珊瑚虫构建出巨大的石灰石骨架，支撑着数以千计的多样海洋物种。生活在珊瑚虫内部的藻类吸收阳光，提供必需的食物养分。上升的海水温度会导致珊瑚逆境和白化，危及海洋生态系统。海洋保护区限制捕捞和污染，以保护这些至关重要的活体栖息地。

questions.q: What protection do coral reefs provide for coastal shores?
What structures do coral polyps construct?
How do algae inside coral polyps contribute nutrients?
options: Absorb sunlight to provide food nutrients

questions.q: What effect do rising sea temperatures have on corals?
How do marine reserves help preserve coral habitats?
What living organisms form the foundation of coral skeletons?

text.en: Human writing began thousands of years ago in ancient Mesopotamia and Song Dynasty China. Early scribes carved wedge-shaped symbols onto wet clay tablets to record trade transactions. In China, characters were inscribed on oracle bones and bronze vessels for historical records. The development of written language enabled humans to store knowledge across generations. Today written scripts connect civilizations through literature, law, and history.
text.zh: 人类文字始于几千年前的古美索不达米亚和中国宋朝。早期的抄写员在湿黏土板上刻下楔形符号，以记录贸易交易。在中国，文字被刻在甲骨和青铜器上作为历史记录。书面语言的发展使人类能够跨世代存储知识。今天，书面文字通过文学、法律和历史将文明连接在一起。

questions.q: Where did human writing begin thousands of years ago?
What material did early scribes carve wedge-shaped symbols onto?
Where were early Chinese characters inscribed for historical records?
How did the development of written language benefit humanity?
options: Enabled humans to store knowledge across generations

questions.q: What connects human civilizations today through written scripts?
What was the initial primary purpose of recording symbols on clay tablets?

text.en: Ocean currents are massive continuous rivers of seawater flowing through Earth's oceans. Wind patterns, water temperature differences, and Earth's rotation drive these global currents. Warm currents carry tropical heat toward cold polar regions, regulating global climate. Marine animals like whales and sea turtles use ocean currents for long migrations. Understanding ocean currents helps meteorologists forecast global weather patterns accurately.
text.zh: 洋流是流经地球海洋的巨大连续海水河流。风向模式、水温差异和地球自转驱动着这些全球洋流。暖流将热带的热量带往寒冷的极地地区，调节着全球气候。像鲸鱼和海龟这样的海洋动物利用洋流进行长途迁徙。了解洋流有助于气象学家准确预测全球天气模式。

questions.q: What are ocean currents described as?
What factors drive global ocean currents?
options: Wind, temperature differences, and Earth's rotation

questions.q: How do warm ocean currents regulate global climate?
options: Carry tropical heat toward cold polar regions

questions.q: Which animals utilize ocean currents for long migrations?
How does studying ocean currents assist meteorologists?
What direction do warm ocean currents flow from?
options: From tropical regions toward polar zones

text.en: Earth's water moves continuously through a natural cycle of evaporation, condensation, and precipitation. Heat from the sun warms ocean water, turning it into invisible water vapor gas. Rising water vapor cools in the atmosphere to form clouds through condensation. Heavy clouds release fresh rain or snow that fills rivers, lakes, and reservoirs. Eventually river water flows back into the oceans, completing the endless cycle.
text.zh: 地球上的水通过蒸发、凝结和降水的自然循环不断运动。来自太阳的热量使海水变暖，转化为看不见的水蒸气气体。上升的水蒸气在大气中冷却，通过凝结形成云。沉重的云层释放出新鲜的雨雪，填满河流、湖泊和水库。最终，河水流回海洋，完成这无休止的循环。

questions.q: What natural processes comprise the global water cycle?
What converts ocean water into invisible water vapor?
How do clouds form in the upper atmosphere?
options: Rising water vapor cools and condenses

questions.q: What happens when clouds become heavy with moisture?
Where does river water eventually flow back to complete the cycle?
What form is water in after evaporation?

text.en: Certain ocean organisms produce brilliant glowing light through natural chemical reactions inside their bodies. Microscopic plankton glow bright neon blue when ocean waves crash along night shores. Deep-sea jellyfish and anglerfish use light flashes to signal mates or confuse predators. Scientists study bioluminescent chemistry to develop non-toxic glowing dyes and medical tools. This mesmerizing natural phenomenon reveals the remarkable adaptations of marine life.
text.zh: 某些海洋生物通过体内的自然化学反应产生璀璨的发光。当海浪在夜间海岸拍打时，微小的浮游生物散发出亮丽的霓虹蓝色光芒。深海水母和琵琶鱼利用闪光信号吸引配偶或迷惑捕食者。科学家研究生物发光化学，开发出无毒发光染料和医疗工具。这种迷人的自然现象揭示了海洋生物卓越的适应能力。

questions.q: How do certain ocean organisms produce brilliant light?
options: Through natural chemical reactions in bodies

questions.q: What color do microscopic plankton glow when waves crash?
Why do deep-sea jellyfish use light flashes?
options: To signal mates or confuse predators

questions.q: What applications do scientists develop from studying bioluminescence?
options: Non-toxic glowing dyes and medical tools

questions.q: What does this natural light phenomenon demonstrate about marine life?
Where can glowing microscopic plankton be seen glowing clearly?
options: Along night shores when waves crash

text.en: Power stations generate electricity using natural energy sources like wind, water, and solar. High-voltage power lines transmit electrical current across hundreds of miles to transformer substations. Substations reduce the voltage safely before sending electricity into neighborhood homes and schools. Circuit breakers and insulated cables protect electrical systems from overload and fires. Electricity powers lights, refrigerators, computers, and medical equipment vital for modern life.
text.zh: 发电站利用风、水和太阳能等自然能源发电。高压输电线路将电流传输数百英里到变电站。变电站在将电力发送到社区家庭和学校之前，安全地降低电压。断路器和绝缘电缆保护电力系统免受过载和火灾。电力为灯光、冰箱、电脑和对现代生活至关重要的医疗设备提供动力。

questions.q: How do power stations generate electricity?
options: Using wind, water, and solar energy sources

questions.q: What carries electrical current across long distances to substations?
What is the function of transformer substations?
options: Reduces voltage safely before home distribution

questions.q: What components protect electrical systems from overload and fires?
Which modern devices rely on grid electricity to function?
options: Lights, refrigerators, computers, and medical tools

questions.q: How far can high-voltage lines transmit electrical current?

text.en: A total solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes directly between Earth and the sun. The moon casts a dark shadow that temporarily blocks sunlight from reaching parts of Earth. During totality, the bright daytime sky turns dark as stars become visible at noon. Scientists study the sun's outer atmosphere, called the corona, during these rare events. Spectators must wear certified solar viewing glasses to protect their eyes safely.
text.zh: 当月球直接穿过地球和太阳之间时，就会发生日全食。月球投下暗影，暂时阻挡阳光到达地球的部分地区。在全食期间，明亮的白昼天空变暗，数颗星星在中午变得清晰可见。在这些罕见的事件中，科学家们研究被称为日冕的太阳外层大气。观赏者必须佩戴经过认证的太阳观赏眼镜，以安全地保护眼睛。

questions.q: What causes a total solar eclipse?
options: The moon passes directly between Earth and sun

questions.q: What does the moon cast over Earth during an eclipse?
What phenomenon occurs during the period of totality?
options: Daytime sky turns dark and stars become visible

questions.q: What outer layer of the sun do scientists study during an eclipse?
What protective gear must spectators wear to observe a solar eclipse?
What celestial body blocks the sunlight during a solar eclipse?

text.en: Volcanic islands are formed when undersea volcanoes erupt repeatedly over millions of years. Deep ocean magma builds up layer by layer until lava breaks above the sea surface. Wind and ocean currents carry seeds, spores, and small animals to the new volcanic land. Over centuries, rich volcanic soil supports lush tropical rainforests and unique wildlife. The Hawaiian Islands were created through this fascinating process of volcanic geology.
text.zh: 当海底火山在数百万年里反复喷发时，就会形成火山岛。深海岩浆一层层积聚，直到熔岩冲破海面。风和洋流将种子、孢子和小动物带到这片新的火山土地上。几个世纪以来，肥沃的火山土壤滋养着茂密的热带雨林和独特的野生动物。夏威夷群岛就是通过这种迷人的火山地质过程创造出来的。

questions.q: How are volcanic islands created over millions of years?
What material builds up layer by layer beneath the sea?
How do plant seeds and small animals reach new volcanic islands?
options: Carried by wind and ocean currents

questions.q: What ecosystem develops on fertile volcanic island soil over centuries?
options: Lush tropical rainforests and unique wildlife

questions.q: Which famous island chain was formed through volcanic activity?
What breaks above the sea surface when a volcanic island emerges?

text.en: Clean drinking water is essential for maintaining public health in towns and cities worldwide. Water treatment plants filter raw river water through layers of sand, gravel, and charcoal. Chlorination kills harmful bacteria and pathogens before water enters distribution pipes. Underground networks deliver purified water directly to home faucets and schools. Conserving water resources ensures that future generations have reliable access to clean water.
text.zh: 干净的饮用水对于维持世界各地城镇的公共卫生至关重要。水处理厂将未经处理的河水穿过沙子、碎石和活性炭层进行过滤。在水进入输水管之前，氯化处理会杀灭有害细菌和病原体。地下网络将净化后的水直接送到家庭龙头和学校。节约水资源能确保后代获得可靠的干净水。

What materials filter raw river water inside treatment plants?

desc.en: Actions happening right now.
desc.zh: 正在发生的动作。

rule.en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing to talk about actions happening right now.
rule.zh: 使用 am/is/are + 动词-ing 表示正在发生的动作。

She is ___ a storybook now.
They are ___ soccer in the yard.
Listen! The birds are ___ in the tree.
I am ___ my homework right now.
He is ___ delicious soup in the kitchen.
The children are ___ happy songs together.

desc.en: Past actions ending in -ed.
desc.zh: 过去发生的规则动作 (-ed)。

rule.en: Add '-ed' to regular verbs to talk about completed past events.
rule.zh: 规则动词末尾加 '-ed' 表示过去完成的事。

questions.q: Yesterday, I ___ in the park.
She ___ her grandmother last Sunday.
They ___ basketball after school yesterday.
He ___ to music for an hour last night.
We ___ our hands before lunch.
The rain ___ two hours ago.
Mom ___ a delicious cake for my birthday.

title.zh: 一般过去时：不规则动词

desc.en: Common irregular past verbs (went, ate, saw).
desc.zh: 常见不规则过去式动词。

rule.en: Irregular verbs change form in the past tense (go -> went, eat -> ate, see -> saw, buy -> bought).
rule.zh: 不规则动词过去式改变形式（如 go->went, eat->ate, see->saw）。

questions.q: Yesterday, we ___ to the zoo.
He ___ an apple for breakfast this morning.
I ___ a beautiful bird in the tree yesterday.
She ___ a new book last week.
They ___ milk before going to bed.
We ___ a great film last night.
The boy ___ his keys yesterday afternoon.

title.zh: 过去进行时：Was 与 Were

desc.en: Was and Were for actions in progress in the past.
desc.zh: 使用 Was / Were 表示过去正在进行的动作。

rule.en: Use 'was' with singular subjects (I, he, she, it) and 'were' with plural subjects (we, you, they).
rule.zh: 单数主语（I/He/She/It）用 was，复数主语（We/You/They）用 were。

questions.q: The chickens ___ running across the farmyard.
I ___ writing a letter at 8 PM yesterday.
The boys ___ playing football in the rain.
She ___ sleeping when the telephone rang.
We ___ studying together all evening.
The cat ___ chasing a mouse under the table.
They ___ waiting for the bus at 7 AM.

desc.en: Compare two people, animals, or things.
desc.zh: 比较两个人或事物。

rule.en: Add '-er' to short adjectives (taller, faster) and use 'more' before long adjectives (more beautiful).
rule.zh: 短形容词加 '-er'，多音节形容词前加 'more'。

questions.q: An elephant is ___ than a dog.
Tom is ___ than his younger brother.
A sports car is ___ than a bicycle.
This flower is ___ than that one.
My house is ___ than yours.
English is ___ than math for me.
Today is ___ than yesterday.

desc.en: Compare three or more things.
desc.zh: 三个或以上事物的最高级比较。

rule.en: Use 'the -est' for short adjectives (the tallest) and 'the most' for long adjectives (the most famous).
rule.zh: 短形容词前加 the，词尾加 -est；长形容词前加 the most。

questions.q: Jupiter is the ___ planet in our solar system.
Giraffes are the ___ land animals.
Cheetahs are the ___ animals on land.
This is the ___ story in the book.
Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
July is usually the ___ month of the year here.
She is the ___ girl in our class.

desc.en: Use me, him, her, us, and them after verbs.
desc.zh: 动词后使用 me, him, her, us, them。

rule.en: Object pronouns (me, him, her, it, us, them) receive the action of a verb.
rule.zh: 宾格代词（me, him, her, us, them）充当动词的宾语。

questions.q: Please help ___ with this heavy box.
John is nice. I like ___ very much.
Anna is friendly. We invited ___ to our party.
The teacher gave ___ a great star.
Look at those birds! Can you see ___?
My brother called ___ on the phone.
We saw Tom and Ben and spoke to ___.

desc.en: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.
desc.zh: 学习 mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs。

rule.en: Possessive pronouns stand alone without a noun (This bag is mine).
rule.zh: 名词性物主代词单独使用，不带名词（如 This bag is mine）。

questions.q: This pen belongs to me. It is ___.
That hat belongs to Mary. It is ___.
Is this coat yours or ___?
We bought this house. It is ___.
They park their car here. That red car is ___.
I have my umbrella. Where is ___?
The blue notebook on the desk is ___.

desc.en: Always, usually, sometimes, never.
desc.zh: 学习频度副词的用法与位置。

rule.en: Place frequency adverbs before main verbs, but after 'be' verbs.
rule.zh: 频度副词放在行为动词前，be 动词后。

questions.q: He ___ eats breakfast at 7 AM.
She is ___ cheerful in the morning.
I ___ walk to school on sunny days.
They ___ play football on weekends.
My grandfather ___ drinks coffee late at night.
We are ___ late for our classes.
She ___ reads bedtime stories to her sister.

title.en: Prepositions of Time: At, On, In

desc.en: Use at for times, on for days, in for months/years.
desc.zh: At 接时刻，On 接具体日期，In 接月份/年份。

rule.en: Use 'at' for clock times (at 8 AM), 'on' for days/dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months/years (in July).
rule.zh: 'at' 接具体点钟，'on' 接具体星期和日期，'in' 接月份、年份和季节。

questions.q: Our class starts ___ 8:00 AM.
We do not go to school ___ Sunday.
My birthday is ___ October.
The concert is ___ May 15th.
It snows a lot here ___ winter.
He goes to sleep ___ night.
We visited Beijing ___ 2024.

desc.en: Many, much, some, and any.
desc.zh: Many, much, some, any 的辨析使用。

rule.en: Use 'many' with countable plural nouns and 'much' with uncountable nouns. Use 'some' in positive statements.
rule.zh: 'many' 修饰复数可数名词，'much' 修饰不可数名词，肯定句用 'some'。

questions.q: How ___ apples are on the table?
How ___ water is in the glass?
I have ___ milk in my cup.
Do you have ___ questions?
There are ___ books on the shelf.
We do not have ___ sugar left.
How ___ money do you need?

title.en: Future Tense: Will vs Going To
title.zh: 将来时：Will 与 Going to

desc.en: Express future plans and predictions.
desc.zh: 表达将来计划与预测。

rule.en: Use 'will' for spontaneous decisions/promises and 'be going to' for planned actions.
rule.zh: 'will' 用于临时决定/承诺，'be going to' 用于打算好的计划。

questions.q: Tomorrow, I ___ visit my grandparents.
She is ___ to buy a new bicycle next week.
Don't worry, I ___ help you with that.
Look at the dark clouds! It is ___ to rain.
We ___ travel to Shanghai this weekend.
They are ___ to watch a movie tonight.
I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.

title.en: Conjunctions: And, But, Or, So, Because
title.zh: 连词：And, But, Or, So, Because

desc.en: Join clauses and sentences together.
desc.zh: 连接分句与句子。

rule.en: Use 'and' for addition, 'but' for contrast, 'or' for choices, 'because' for reasons, and 'so' for results.
rule.zh: 'and' 递进，'but' 转折，'or' 选择，'because' 因果，'so' 结果。

questions.q: I like apples ___ I like bananas.
He ran fast, ___ he missed the bus.
I stayed at home ___ it was raining.
Would you like tea ___ coffee?
She studied hard, ___ she passed the test.
He was tired, ___ he went to bed early.
We stayed indoors ___ the weather was cold.

desc.en: Must for strong rules, should for advice.
desc.zh: Must 表示必须，Should 表示建议。

rule.en: Use 'must' for strong obligation/rules and 'should' for friendly advice.
rule.zh: 'must' 表示强烈的规则/义务，'should' 表示建议。

questions.q: You ___ stop when the traffic light is red.
You ___ eat more vegetables to stay healthy.
Students ___ be quiet in the library.
It is raining outside. You ___ take an umbrella.
Drivers ___ obey the speed limit.
You ___ brush your teeth twice a day.
We ___ protect environment for our future.

desc.en: Myself, yourself, himself, herself.
desc.zh: 学习 myself, yourself, himself, herself。

rule.en: Use reflexive pronouns when the subject and object are the same person.
rule.zh: 当主语和宾语为同一人时使用反身代词。

questions.q: He taught ___ how to play guitar.
She looked at ___ in the mirror.
I made this cake all by ___.
Be careful! Don't hurt ___ with the knife.
The cat cleaned ___ with its tongue.
We enjoyed ___ at the party.
They prepared the meal by ___.

writing.en: If you could have any superpower for one day, what would it be and how would you use it?
writing.zh: 如果你能拥有一天的超能力，你想要什么？你会怎么使用它？

writing.en: Imagine you found a secret door in your bedroom. Where does it lead to?
writing.zh: 想象你在卧室里发现了一扇秘密门。它通向哪里？

writing.en: What is your favorite hobby? Why do you enjoy doing it in your free time?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的爱好是什么？为什么你喜欢在空闲时间做这件事？

writing.en: If you could invent a robot to help you with chores, what would it look like and what would it do?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一个机器人帮你做家务，它长什么样，会做什么？

writing.en: Describe the perfect treehouse. What rooms and fun things would you have inside?
writing.zh: 描述一下完美的树屋。里面会有什么房间和好玩的东西？

writing.en: If you were a famous explorer, what place in the world would you want to discover?
writing.zh: 如果你是一位著名的探险家，你想去发现世界上哪个地方？

writing.en: Write a story about a pet that can talk. What do you think they would say to you?
writing.zh: 写一个关于会说话的宠物的故事。你觉得他们会对你说什么？

writing.en: Imagine you could travel to space. Which planet would you visit and what would you look for?
writing.zh: 想象你可以去太空旅行。你想去哪个星球？你想寻找什么？

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What are three fun things you like to do together?
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们最喜欢一起做的三件有趣的事情是什么？

writing.en: If it rained your favorite food instead of water, what would it be and how would you catch it?
writing.zh: 如果天上下的不是雨，而是你最喜欢的食物，那会是什么？你会怎么接住它？

writing.en: What would you do if you were the principal of your school for a day?
writing.zh: 如果你做了一天的校长，你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you found a magic pencil that makes whatever you draw become real. What is the first thing you draw?
writing.zh: 想象你找到了一支神奇的铅笔，能让你画的东西变成现实。你画的第一样东西是什么？

writing.en: If you could shrink down to the size of an ant, what adventure would you go on in your backyard?
writing.zh: 如果你能缩到蚂蚁那么小，你会在后院进行什么探险？

writing.en: Write about a time you helped someone. How did it make you feel?
writing.zh: 写一次你帮助别人的经历。这让你感觉如何？

writing.en: If animals could have jobs, what job would a dog have and why?
writing.zh: 如果动物也有工作，狗会做什么工作？为什么？

writing.en: Describe your favorite outdoor activity. Why is it fun to do outside?
writing.zh: 描述你最喜欢的户外活动。为什么在户外做这件事很有趣？

writing.en: Imagine you are stranded on a desert island. What three items would you want to have with you?
writing.zh: 想象你被困在荒岛上。你希望随身携带哪三样东西？

writing.en: If you could only eat one color of food for a week, what color would you choose and what would you eat?
writing.zh: 如果一个星期你只能吃一种颜色的食物，你会选什么颜色？你会吃什么？

writing.en: Write a story about a friendly dragon who comes to visit your town.
writing.zh: 写一个关于一条友好的龙来拜访你的小镇的故事。

writing.en: If you could breathe underwater, what kind of sea creatures would you want to play with?
writing.zh: 如果你能在水下呼吸，你想和什么样的海洋生物一起玩？

writing.en: What makes a good friend? Write about why being kind and sharing is important.
writing.zh: 什么是好朋友？写写为什么善良和分享很重要。

writing.en: Imagine you have a time machine. Would you travel to the past or the future, and why?
writing.zh: 想象你有一台时光机。你想穿越到过去还是未来，为什么？

writing.en: If you could create a new holiday, what would it celebrate and how would people celebrate it?
writing.zh: 如果你能创造一个新节日，它庆祝什么？人们会怎么庆祝它？

writing.en: Write about a time when you tried something new and difficult. Did you succeed or learn from it?
writing.zh: 写一次你尝试既新颖又困难的事情的经历。你成功了吗，或者从中学到了什么？

writing.en: If you could be any character from a book or movie, who would you be and what would you do?
writing.zh: 如果你能成为书本或电影里的任何一个角色，你想成为谁？你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you woke up and you were invisible. How would you spend your day?
writing.zh: 想象你醒来发现自己隐身了。你会怎么度过这一天？

writing.en: What is the best gift you have ever given someone? Why was it special?
writing.zh: 你送给别人最好的礼物是什么？为什么它很特别？

writing.en: If you could build a vehicle that travels on land, water, and air, what would it look like?
writing.zh: 如果你能制造一辆可以在陆地、水上和空中行驶的交通工具，它会是什么样子？

writing.en: Write a story about a day when all the toys in your room came alive.
writing.zh: 写一个关于你房间里所有玩具都活过来的一天的故事。

writing.en: If you could learn any language in the world instantly, which one would it be and who would you talk to?
writing.zh: 如果你能立刻学会世界上的任何一种语言，你会选哪一种？你想和谁说话？

writing.en: Imagine you found a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Where do you think it leads?
writing.zh: 想象你在沙滩上的一个瓶子里发现了一张藏宝图。你觉得它通向哪里？

writing.en: What is your favorite season of the year? Write about the fun things you do during that time.
writing.zh: 你最喜欢一年中的哪个季节？写写在那个时候你做的有趣的事情。

writing.en: If you were a superhero, what would your name be and what costume would you wear?
writing.zh: 如果你是个超级英雄，你的名字会叫什么？你会穿什么样的服装？

writing.en: Write about a time you went on a fun trip with your family. What was the best part?
writing.zh: 写一次你和家人一起进行的有趣旅行。最棒的部分是什么？

writing.en: If you could have a wild animal as a pet, what would it be and how would you take care of it?
writing.zh: 如果你能养一只野生动物当宠物，你会养什么？你会怎么照顾它？

writing.en: Imagine you can fly like a bird. What places would you fly to and look at from above?
writing.zh: 想象你能像鸟儿一样飞翔。你会飞到哪些地方从上面俯瞰？

writing.en: What is an invention you wish existed to make your morning routine easier?
writing.zh: 你希望有什么发明能让你早上的日常生活变得更容易？

writing.en: If you had a magical garden, what kind of weird and wonderful plants would grow there?
writing.zh: 如果你有一个神奇花园，那里会生长什么奇特而美妙的植物？

writing.en: Write a story about a brave knight who has to rescue a lost kitten instead of a princess.
writing.zh: 写一个关于勇敢骑士不去救公主，而是去救一只走失的小猫的故事。

writing.en: If you could swap lives with your pet for one day, what do you think you would do?
writing.zh: 如果你能和你的宠物交换一天的生活，你觉得你会做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you found a pair of shoes that let you run super fast. Where would you run to?
writing.zh: 想象你发现了一双能让你跑得超级快的鞋。你会跑到哪里去？

writing.en: What is something you are really good at doing? How did you learn to do it so well?
writing.zh: 你非常擅长做的一件事是什么？你是怎么学得这么好的？

writing.en: If you could turn your classroom into anything for a day, what would it be? (e.g., a jungle, a spaceship)
writing.zh: 如果你能让你的教室变成任何东西一天，那会是什么？（比如：丛林、宇宙飞船）

writing.en: Write a story about an alien who comes to your school and tries to learn how to play soccer.
writing.zh: 写一个关于外星人来到你的学校，并试图学习踢足球的故事。

writing.en: If you could design your own amusement park, what would the biggest roller coaster be like?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计自己的游乐园，最大的过山车会是什么样的？

writing.en: Imagine you have a camera that takes pictures of the future. What do you see in the photos?
writing.zh: 想象你有一台能拍到未来照片的相机。你在照片里看到了什么？

writing.en: What is the most amazing dream you have ever had? Describe what happened.
writing.zh: 你做过最不可思议的梦是什么？描述一下发生了什么。

writing.en: If you could combine two animals to make a new one, what would they be and what would you call it?
writing.zh: 如果你能把两种动物结合成一种新动物，会是哪两种？你会叫它什么？

writing.en: Write about a time you solved a difficult puzzle or problem. How did you figure it out?
writing.zh: 写一次你解决一个困难的谜题或问题的经历。你是怎么想出办法的？

writing.en: If your town had a giant snowstorm and you had the day off school, what would you do in the snow?
writing.zh: 如果你的小镇下了一场大暴风雪，你放假一天，你会在雪地里做什么？

writing.en: Imagine you have a magic backpack that always has exactly what you need. What does it give you today?
writing.zh: 想象你有一个神奇的背包，里面总是有你需要的东西。今天它给了你什么？

writing.en: If you could interview a famous historical figure, who would it be and what would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能采访一位著名的历史人物，你会选谁？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: Write a story about two kids who discover their treehouse can fly.
writing.zh: 写一个关于两个孩子发现他们的树屋能飞的故事。

writing.en: What is your favorite board game or video game? Why do you think it is so fun to play?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的棋盘游戏或电子游戏是什么？你为什么觉得它这么好玩？

writing.en: If you could only listen to one song for the rest of your life, what would it be and why?
writing.zh: 如果你这辈子只能听一首歌，那会是什么？为什么？

writing.en: Imagine you are a detective trying to solve the mystery of a missing school bell. Where do you look?
writing.zh: 想象你是一名侦探，试图解开学校铃铛失踪的谜团。你会在哪里寻找？

writing.en: If you could create a brand new flavor of ice cream, what ingredients would be in it?
writing.zh: 如果你能创造一种全新的冰淇淋口味，里面会有什么配料？

writing.en: Write about a day when everything went completely backwards. How did you eat breakfast?
writing.zh: 写写一切都完全倒转的一天。你是怎么吃早餐的？

writing.en: If you could have a conversation with the sun, what would you ask it about its day?
writing.zh: 如果你能和太阳对话，你会问它这一天过得怎么样？

writing.en: Imagine you are standing on top of the tallest mountain in the world. What do you yell out?
writing.zh: 想象你站在世界上最高的山峰顶上。你会大声喊出什么？

What did you do on the weekend?
Let us go to the park to play.
My brother likes playing video games.
speaking.zh: 我哥哥喜欢玩电子游戏。

speaking.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
I am so happy to see you.
I like to read books in the library.
What time do you go to school?
My favorite color is blue.
speaking.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色。

speaking.en: Can you help me with my homework?
There are many apples in the basket.
The weather is sunny and warm today.
I want to be a doctor when I grow up.
speaking.zh: 我长大后想当一名医生。

speaking.en: She plays the piano very well.
Where is the nearest supermarket?
We eat lunch at twelve o'clock.
Do you have a pet at home?
It is important to brush your teeth.
Look at the birds in the sky.
My brother plays basketball every Sunday.
speaking.zh: 我弟弟每个星期天都打篮球。

speaking.en: Please pass me the salt.
I am taller than my friend.
The school bus is yellow.
She is wearing a beautiful dress.
speaking.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的连衣裙。

speaking.en: Let's go to the park to play.
How many students are in your class?
I drink milk every morning.
The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
What are you doing now?
I finished my homework on time.
Today is my father's birthday.
I like to read books in the library.
What time do you go to school?
My favorite fruit is a red apple.
speaking.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是红苹果。

speaking.en: Can you play basketball with me?
speaking.zh: 你能和我一起打篮球吗？

speaking.en: There are forty students in my class.
She is wearing a beautiful blue dress.
speaking.zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的蓝裙子。

speaking.en: It is sunny and warm today.
I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
speaking.zh: 我长大后想成为一名老师。

speaking.en: Where is my pencil box?
Let us go to the park this afternoon.
speaking.zh: 让我们今天下午去公园吧。

speaking.en: How many brothers do you have?
The elephant is very big and strong.
I help my mother wash the dishes.
Do you like to eat noodles for breakfast?
The cat is sleeping under the table.
I have an English class on Mondays.
Please open your book to page ten.
My father drives a white car.
speaking.zh: 我爸爸开一辆白色的车。

speaking.en: Winter is cold and it often snows.
speaking.zh: 冬天很冷，而且经常下雪。

speaking.en: Look at the colorful flowers in the garden.
speaking.zh: 看花园里五颜六色的花。

speaking.en: I am taller than my little brother.
Do you have a pet at home?
The school bus is coming now.
We study math, science and art.
speaking.zh: 我们学习数学、科学和美术。

speaking.en: Have a nice day, my friend!
speaking.zh: 祝你有美好的一天，我的朋友！
