text.en: Eight unique planets revolve around our central star, the sun. Earth is the only planet known to support living plants and animals. Astronomers use telescopes to discover new stars and moons in outer space.
text.zh: 八大独特的行星围绕着我们的中心恒星——太阳旋转。地球是唯一已知能维持活生生的植物和动物生存的行星。天文学家使用望远镜在大太空探索新的恒星和卫星。

questions.q: How many planets revolve around the sun?
Which planet is known to support living plants and animals?
What tool do astronomers use to discover new stars?

text.en: Clean oceans are vital for maintaining life across planet Earth. Marine animals often mistake floating plastic trash for food, which harms their health. Volunteers work hard during beach cleanups to remove waste from shores.
text.zh: 干净的海洋对于维持地球上的生命至关重要。海洋动物常常把漂浮的塑料垃圾误认为食物，这损害了它们的健康。志愿者们在沙滩清理过程中辛勤工作，清除海岸上的垃圾。

questions.q: Why are clean oceans vital?
What do marine animals often mistake for food?
What do volunteers remove from shores during beach cleanups?

text.en: Early computers built in the mid-twentieth century occupied entire large rooms. Over decades, engineers created small microchips that made computers faster and lighter. Today portable laptops and smartphones help people work, communicate, and learn everywhere.
text.zh: 二十世纪中期制造的早期计算机占据了整个大房间。几十年来，工程师们创造了小微芯片，使计算机更快、更轻。如今，便携式手提电脑和智能手机帮助人们在各处工作、沟通和学习。

questions.q: Where were early computers located in the mid-twentieth century?
What component made computers faster and lighter?
What devices help people work and learn everywhere today?

text.en: Wind energy is a clean renewable resource that produces no air pollution. Giant wind turbines catch strong wind currents on high hills to spin internal generators. Clean electricity generated by wind turbines powers thousands of modern homes.
text.zh: 风能是一种不产生空气污染的清洁可再生资源。巨型风力发电机在高山上捕捉强风气流，旋转内部发电机。风力发电机产生的清洁电力为数以千计的现代家庭提供动力。

questions.q: What type of resource is wind energy?
Where are giant wind turbines located?
What powers thousands of modern homes?

text.en: Green plants make their own food through a natural process called photosynthesis. Plant leaves use green chlorophyll to absorb energy from bright sunlight. In return, plants release fresh oxygen gas for humans and animals to breathe.
text.zh: 绿色植物通过一种被称为光合作用的自然过程制造自己的食物。植物叶子使用绿色叶绿素从明亮的阳光中吸收能量。作为回报，植物释放出新鲜的氧气供人类和动物呼吸。

questions.q: What process do green plants use to make food?
What do plant leaves use to absorb energy from sunlight?
What gas do plants release for humans and animals to breathe?

text.en: Robotic space rovers travel across the dry rocky surface of Mars. Equipped with high-resolution cameras, these rovers take detailed photos for scientists. Scientists examine rock samples to discover clues about ancient water on Mars.
text.zh: 机器人太空巡视器在火星干燥的多岩石表面上行进。装备有高分辨率相机，这些巡视器为科学家拍摄详细的照片。科学家检查岩石样本，以发现关于火星古老水域的线索。

questions.q: Where do robotic space rovers travel?
options: Across the dry rocky surface of Mars

questions.q: What tool do rovers use to take detailed photos?
What clues do scientists search for in rock samples?

text.en: The Amazon rainforest is the largest tropical rainforest in the world. Millions of unique animal and plant species thrive in its warm humid climate. Dense rainforest trees absorb vast amounts of carbon dioxide to balance global temperatures.
text.zh: 亚马逊雨林是世界上最大的热带雨林。数以百万计的独特动植物物种在其温暖潮湿的气候中茁壮成长。茂密的雨林树木吸收大量的二氧化碳，以平衡全球气温。

questions.q: Which is the largest tropical rainforest in the world?
What climate exists in the Amazon rainforest?
What do dense rainforest trees absorb to balance global temperatures?

text.en: The Great Wall of China stretches thousands of miles across steep mountains. Built centuries ago, ancient soldiers used stone watchtowers to guard national borders. Today millions of tourists from all over the world visit this historic monument.
text.zh: 中国长城跨越陡峭的山脉绵延数千英里。建立于几个世纪前，古代士兵使用石砌烽火台来守卫国家边境。今天，来自世界各地的数百万游客游览这一历史遗迹。

questions.q: Where does the Great Wall stretch across?
Who used stone watchtowers to guard borders centuries ago?
Who visits the Great Wall today?

text.en: Coral reefs are vibrant marine habitats formed by tiny living coral polyps. Thousands of colorful fish species rely on coral branches for food and shelter. Protecting coral reefs from water pollution ensures sea animals stay healthy.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是由微小的活体珊瑚虫形成的生机勃勃的海洋栖息地。数千种彩色的鱼类依靠珊瑚枝桠寻找食物和庇护所。保护珊瑚礁免受水污染能确保海洋动物保持健康。

questions.q: What living organisms form coral reefs?
What do colorful fish rely on coral branches for?
Why is protecting coral reefs from pollution important?

text.en: Electric cars use rechargeable battery packs instead of gasoline engines. Charging electric vehicles with clean solar or wind energy reduces air pollution. Modern automakers build faster and more efficient electric cars every year.
text.zh: 电动汽车使用可充电电池组而不是汽油发动机。用清洁的太阳能或风能为电动汽车充电可以减少空气污染。现代汽车制造商每年都在制造更快、更高效的电动汽车。

questions.q: What power source do electric cars use instead of gasoline?
How does charging electric vehicles with clean energy benefit the air?
What do modern automakers build every year?
options: Faster and more efficient electric cars

text.en: Honeybees play a vital role in pollinating wild flowers and farm crops. While collecting nectar, bees transfer pollen grains from one blossom to another. This natural process allows plants to grow fresh seeds, nuts, and fruits.
text.zh: 蜜蜂在野花和农作物的授粉中发挥着至关重要的作用。在收集花蜜时，蜜蜂将花粉粒从一朵花传递到另一朵花。这一自然过程使植物能够结出新鲜的种子、坚果和水果。

questions.q: What vital role do honeybees play in nature?
What do bees transfer between blossoms while collecting nectar?
What does pollination allow plants to produce?

text.en: The Great Pyramids of Giza were built thousands of years ago in ancient Egypt. Workers moved massive limestone blocks across desert sands to construct royal tombs. Today these architectural marvels attract millions of historians and travelers.
text.zh: 吉萨大金字塔建造于几千年前的古埃及。工人们将巨大的石灰石块切推过沙漠沙地，建造皇家陵墓。今天，这些建筑奇迹吸引着数以百万计的历史学家和旅行者。

questions.q: Where were the Great Pyramids of Giza built?
What material did workers move across desert sands?
Why were the pyramids originally constructed?

text.en: The deep ocean floor remains one of the most unexplored places on Earth. Scientists deploy advanced robotic submarines equipped with bright lights into pitch darkness. Mysterious glowing creatures and unique underwater volcanoes live in this deep habitat.
text.zh: 深海海底仍然是地球上最未经探索的地方之一。科学家们将配备明亮灯光的先进机器人潜水艇部署到漆黑的大洋深处。神秘的发光生物和水下火山生活在这个深海栖息地中。

questions.q: How is the deep ocean floor described?
What equipment do scientists deploy into the dark ocean?
What lives in the deep ocean habitat?
options: Mysterious glowing creatures and underwater volcanoes

text.en: Movable type printing was pioneered by Bi Sheng in Song Dynasty China. Individual character blocks carved from clay allowed books to be printed efficiently. This groundbreaking invention accelerated education and spread knowledge worldwide.
text.zh: 活字印刷术由中国宋朝的毕昇开创。用黏土雕刻的单个汉字字块使书籍得以高效印刷。这一突破性的发明加速了教育，并在世界范围内传播了知识。

questions.q: Who pioneered movable type printing in Song Dynasty China?
What were the individual character blocks carved from?
What major impact did the printing press have on society?

text.en: Volcanoes form where molten rock called magma rises through Earth's crust. When pressure builds, volcanic eruptions release hot lava flows and ash into the air. Over time, cooled lava hardens into fertile volcanic soil that supports lush plant life.
text.zh: 火山形成于被称为岩浆的熔融岩石上升通过地壳的地方。当压力积聚时，火山喷发向空中释放出灼热的岩浆流和火山灰。随着时间的推移，冷却的岩浆硬化成肥沃的火山土壤，滋养着茂盛的植物生命。

questions.q: What is molten rock beneath Earth's surface called?
What causes volcanic eruptions to occur?
What does cooled lava eventually turn into?
options: Fertile volcanic soil supporting plant life

text.en: Earth's water moves continuously through an endless natural water cycle. Heat from the sun warms ocean water, turning it into invisible water vapor. Rising water vapor cools in the upper atmosphere to form heavy rain clouds. Rain falls back to land and rivers, returning water safely to the oceans.
text.zh: 地球上的水在一个无休止的自然水循环中不断运动。来自太阳的热量使海水变暖，转化为看不见的水蒸气。上升的水蒸气在大气高层冷却，形成沉重的雨云。雨水落回陆地和河流，安全地将水送回海洋。

questions.q: What powers the natural water cycle?
What does ocean water turn into when warmed by sun heat?
How do heavy rain clouds form in the atmosphere?
options: Rising water vapor cools in upper atmosphere

questions.q: Where does rainwater eventually return?

text.en: Orbiting space telescopes capture clear high-definition images of distant galaxies. Positioned high above Earth's atmosphere, these observatories avoid cloud cover and air distortion. Astronomers discover new exoplanets, glowing gas clouds, and exploding stars millions of light-years away. Data collected by space telescopes helps scientists measure the expanding size of our universe.
text.zh: 轨道太空望远镜拍摄遥远星系清晰的高清图像。置于地球大气层的高空，这些天文台避免了云层覆盖和空气扭曲。天文学家在数百万光年之外发现了新的外星行星、发光气体云和爆炸的恒星。太空望远镜收集的数据帮助科学家测量我们宇宙的膨胀规模。

questions.q: Where are orbiting space telescopes positioned?
Why do space telescopes take clearer images than ground telescopes?
options: Avoid cloud cover and air distortion

questions.q: What deep-space objects do astronomers discover?
options: Exoplanets, gas clouds, and exploding stars

questions.q: How does data from space telescopes help scientists?
options: Measures expanding size of our universe

text.en: Solar power systems convert radiant sunlight directly into clean electrical energy. Dark silicon solar panels installed on building roofs absorb sunlight during daytime hours. Special converter devices transform solar energy into electricity for household appliances and lights. Utilizing solar energy reduces dependence on fossil fuels and cuts carbon emissions.
text.zh: 太阳能电力系统将辐射的阳光直接转换为清洁的电能。安装在建筑物屋顶上的黑色硅太阳能电池板在白天吸收阳光。特殊的转换设备将太阳能转换为供家用电器和灯光使用的电力。利用太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并减少碳排放。

questions.q: What do solar power systems convert sunlight into?
Where are dark silicon solar panels typically installed?
What device transforms solar energy into household electricity?
What environmental benefit does using solar power provide?
options: Reduces dependence on fossil fuels and cuts emissions

text.en: The ancient Silk Road was a historical network of trade routes connecting Asia with Europe. Merchants transported valuable goods including Chinese silk, porcelain, tea, and aromatic spices across deserts. Caravan travelers braved harsh weather conditions, mountain passes, and long distances on camels. Along with trade goods, cultural traditions, inventions, and scientific ideas spread between ancient civilizations.
text.zh: 古代丝绸之路是连接亚洲与欧洲的漫大历史贸易路线网络。商人横穿沙漠，运送包括中国丝绸、瓷器、茶叶和芳香香料在内的贵重商品。商队旅人骑着骆驼顶着严酷的天气条件、山谷小隘和遥远的距离前行。除了贸易商品，文化传统、发明和科学思想也在古代文明之间传播。

questions.q: What was the ancient Silk Road?
options: Historical network of trade routes connecting Asia and Europe

questions.q: What valuable goods did merchants transport along the route?
options: Chinese silk, porcelain, tea, and spices

questions.q: What animals did caravan travelers ride across deserts?
What spread between civilizations alongside trade goods?
options: Cultural traditions, inventions, and scientific ideas

text.en: Many bird species undertake extraordinary seasonal migrations across continents every year. Flocks of wild geese fly together in V-shaped formations to reduce air resistance during flight. Migrating birds navigate accurately using Earth's magnetic field, landmarks, and position of the sun. Protecting stopover wetland habitats ensures birds find sufficient food and rest during their journey.
text.zh: 许多鸟类每年都会跨越大洲进行非凡的季节性迁徙。野生大雁群以V字队形一起飞翔，以减少飞行中的空气阻力。迁徙的鸟类利用地球磁场、地标和太阳的位置精确导航。保护中途停留的湿地栖息地确保鸟类在旅途中找到足够的食物和休息。

questions.q: How often do migratory bird species undertake long seasonal journeys?
Why do flocks of wild geese fly in V-shaped formations?
options: To reduce air resistance during flight

questions.q: What natural cues help migrating birds navigate accurately?
options: Earth's magnetic field, landmarks, and sun position

questions.q: Why is protecting stopover wetland habitats vital for migratory birds?
options: Ensures birds find sufficient food and rest

text.en: Alexander Graham Bell patented the first practical electric telephone in 1876. His invention transmitted human voice speech signals over copper wire lines between separate rooms. This groundbreaking communication technology allowed people to converse across long distances instantly. Today advanced wireless smartphones connect billions of global users through digital networks.
text.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔于1876年为第一部实用电动电话申请了专利。他的发明通过铜线在不同的房间之间传输人类语音信号。这项突破性的通信技术使人们能够瞬间进行跨越遥远距离的对话。如今，先进的无线智能手机通过数字网络连接着数十亿全球用户。

questions.q: Who patented the first practical electric telephone in 1876?
How did Bell's early telephone transmit human speech?
What major capability did the telephone provide for people?
options: Allowed instant conversation across long distances

questions.q: How do modern smartphones connect billions of users today?

text.en: Thomas Edison perfected the practical incandescent electric light bulb in 1879. He tested thousands of different carbonized filaments inside vacuum glass bulbs for durability. Electric light bulbs replaced dangerous gas lamps and flickering candles in homes and factories. Safe electric lighting transformed human work schedules, education, and nightlife across cities.
text.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生于1879年完善了实用的白炽灯泡。他在真空玻璃灯泡内测试了数千种不同的炭化灯丝的耐用性。电灯泡取代了房屋和工厂里危险的煤气灯和闪烁的蜡烛。安全的电气照明改变了人类的工作日程、教育和跨城市的夜生活。

questions.q: Who perfected the practical incandescent electric light bulb in 1879?
What component did Edison test inside glass bulbs for durability?
What dangerous older lighting sources did electric bulbs replace?
options: Dangerous gas lamps and flickering candles

questions.q: How did safe electric lighting transform human society?
options: Transformed work schedules, education, and nightlife

text.en: Ocean currents are continuous directional movements of seawater flowing through Earth's oceans. Wind patterns, water temperature variations, and Earth's rotation drive these global marine currents. Warm ocean currents transfer tropical heat toward cold polar regions to regulate global climate. Marine creatures like whales, sea turtles, and fish rely on ocean currents for long migrations.
text.zh: 洋流是流经地球海洋的连续定向海水运动。风向模式、水温变化和地球自转驱动着这些全球海洋流。暖洋流将热带热量向寒冷的极地地区输送，以调节全球气候。像鲸鱼、海龟和鱼类这样的海洋生物依靠洋流进行长途迁徙。

questions.q: What are ocean currents?
What forces drive global marine currents?
options: Wind, temperature variations, and Earth's rotation

questions.q: How do warm ocean currents regulate global climate?
options: Transfer tropical heat toward cold polar regions

questions.q: Which animals rely on ocean currents for long migrations?

text.en: The Grand Canyon in Arizona was carved over millions of years by the Colorado River. Multi-colored layered rock walls reveal steep geological cliffs stretching for hundreds of miles. Unique wildlife species including bighorn sheep and condors inhabit the canyon ecosystem. Millions of international tourists visit national park lookouts to view this natural geological wonder.
text.zh: 亚利桑那州的大峡谷是科罗拉多河经历数百万年切割而成的。多色的分层岩壁展露了绵延数百英里的陡峭地质悬崖。包括大角羊和兀鹰在内的独特野生动物物种栖息在峡谷生态系统中。数以百万计的国际游客游览国家公园观景台，观赏这一自然地质奇观。

questions.q: What river carved the Grand Canyon over millions of years?
In which state is the Grand Canyon located?
What do multi-colored rock walls reveal?
options: Steep geological cliffs stretching hundreds of miles

questions.q: Which animals inhabit the Grand Canyon ecosystem?

text.en: Artificial intelligence involves training computer systems to perform complex human-like tasks. Smart algorithms analyze vast amounts of data to recognize speech, translate languages, and identify patterns. AI technologies assist medical doctors in diagnosing diseases and help drivers navigate traffic safely. Computer scientists work diligently to ensure AI systems are developed safely and ethically.
text.zh: 人工智能包括训练计算机系统来执行复杂的类人任务。智能算法分析大量数据以识别语音、翻译语言并确定模式。AI技术协助医生诊断疾病，并帮助司机安全导航交通。计算机科学家勤奋工作，确保AI系统安全并符合伦理地开发。

questions.q: What does artificial intelligence involve?
options: Training computers to perform complex human-like tasks

questions.q: What can smart AI algorithms do with vast data?
options: Recognize speech, translate languages, and identify patterns

questions.q: How does AI technology assist medical doctors?
What responsibility do computer scientists focus on?
options: Ensure AI systems are developed safely and ethically

text.en: Volcanic islands form when undersea volcanoes erupt repeatedly over millions of years. Deep-sea magma builds up layer upon layer until lava breaks through the ocean surface. Wind and ocean currents carry seeds, plant spores, and small animals to the new land. Over centuries, fertile volcanic ash soil nourishes lush tropical rainforests and unique species.
text.zh: 当海底火山在数百万年里反复喷发时，就会形成火山岛。深海岩浆一层又一层地积聚，直到熔岩冲破海面。风和洋流将种子、植物孢子和小动物带到这片新土地上。几个世纪以来，肥沃的火山灰土壤滋养着茂密的热带雨林和独特的物种。

questions.q: How do volcanic islands form in oceans?
options: Undersea volcanoes erupt repeatedly over millions of years

questions.q: What material builds up layer upon layer beneath the ocean?
How do plant seeds and small animals reach new volcanic islands?
options: Carried by wind and ocean currents

questions.q: What nourishes lush tropical rainforests on volcanic islands over centuries?

text.en: Access to clean drinking water is vital for public health in modern cities. Water treatment facilities filter raw river water through layers of sand, gravel, and charcoal. Chlorination treatment destroys harmful bacteria before water enters underground pipe networks. Purified tap water is delivered directly to homes, schools, and hospitals daily.
text.zh: 获取干净的饮用水对于现代城市的公共卫生至关重要。水处理设施将未经处理的河水穿过沙子、碎石和活性炭层进行过滤。在水进入地下管道网络之前，氯化处理会消灭有害细菌。净化后的自来水每天直接送到家庭、学校和医院。

questions.q: Why is clean drinking water vital for cities?
What materials filter raw river water inside treatment plants?
options: Layers of sand, gravel, and charcoal

questions.q: What process destroys harmful bacteria in water?
Where is purified tap water delivered daily?

text.en: A total solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes directly between Earth and the sun. The moon casts a deep shadow that briefly blocks sunlight from reaching parts of Earth. During totality, daytime sky turns dark as stars become visible at noon. Scientists study the sun's outer corona atmosphere safely during these rare astronomical events.
text.zh: 当月球直接穿过地球和太阳之间时，就会发生日全食。月球投下一道深阴影，短暂地阻挡阳光到达地球的部分地区。在全食期间，白昼天空变暗，数颗星星在中午变得清晰可见。在这些罕见的天文事件中，科学家们安全地研究太阳被称为日冕的外层大气。

questions.q: What causes a total solar eclipse?
options: The moon passes directly between Earth and sun

questions.q: What does the moon cast over Earth during an eclipse?
What happens to the sky during totality?
options: Daytime sky turns dark and stars become visible

questions.q: What outer atmosphere layer of the sun do scientists study?

text.en: James Watt redesigned the steam engine in the 1770s to increase energy efficiency. Steam engines burned coal to boil water into high-pressure steam that moved mechanical pistons. Steam power operated early train locomotives, steamships, and factory manufacturing equipment. This groundbreaking technology triggered the Industrial Revolution, transforming human industry worldwide.
text.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特在18世纪70年代重新设计了蒸汽机，提高能量效率。蒸汽机燃烧煤炭将水煮沸成高压蒸汽，从而推动机械活塞。蒸汽动力操作着早期的铁路火车头、轮船和工厂制造设备。这一突破性的技术引发了工业革命，在世界范围内改变了人类的工业。

questions.q: Who redesigned the steam engine in the 1770s for energy efficiency?
How did steam engines generate mechanical motion?
options: Burned coal to boil water into steam moving pistons

questions.q: What machinery was powered by steam energy?
options: Train locomotives, steamships, and factory equipment

questions.q: What historical revolution was triggered by steam technology?

text.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza stands as a monumental masterpiece of ancient architecture. Built during Pharaoh Khufu's reign, it required over two million heavy stone blocks. Egyptian builders aligned the pyramid's base precisely with cardinal compass directions. Today historians continue studying ancient construction methods used to lift stone blocks weighing tons.
text.zh: 吉萨大金字塔作为古代建筑的史诗级杰作耸立着。在法老胡夫统治时期建造，它需要超过两百万块沉重的石块。埃及建造者将金字塔的底部精确地与基准指南针方向对齐。今天，历史学家们继续研究用于抬升重达数吨的石块的古代建造方法。

questions.q: During whose reign was the Great Pyramid of Giza built?
How many heavy stone blocks were required for construction?
How did Egyptian builders align the pyramid's base?
What do historians continue studying about the pyramids today?
options: Ancient construction methods used to lift heavy stones

text.en: Photosynthesis is the fundamental biological process by which green plants manufacture organic food nutrients. Chlorophyll pigments contained inside leaf cells absorb solar energy from incoming sunlight rays. Plant roots absorb soil water and dissolved minerals, while leaves take in carbon dioxide gas. Solar energy drives chemical reactions that produce glucose sugar while releasing fresh oxygen for living beings.
text.zh: 光合作用是绿色植物制造有机食物养分的基本生物过程。树叶细胞内部包含的叶绿素色素从传入的阳光线中吸收太阳能。植物根部吸收土壤水和溶解的矿物质，而树叶吸收二氧化碳气体。太阳能驱动化学反应产生葡萄糖，同时为生物释放新鲜氧气。

questions.q: What is photosynthesis defined as in plants?
options: Fundamental biological process manufacturing organic nutrients

questions.q: What pigment inside leaf cells absorbs solar energy?
What inputs do plant roots and leaves gather?
options: Soil water, dissolved minerals, and carbon dioxide

questions.q: What outputs are created by photosynthesis reactions?
options: Glucose sugar and fresh oxygen gas

questions.q: Where does the primary energy source for photosynthesis originate?

text.en: Mars has been the prime destination for robotic space exploration for several decades. Advanced autonomous rovers like Perseverance traverse dry rocky lakebeds and meteor craters. Equipped with high-resolution spectrometers and rock drills, rovers analyze ancient Martian geology. Scientists seek biosignature evidence of past microbial life to prepare for future crewed human missions.
text.zh: 火星几十年来一直是机器人太空探索的首要目的地。像“毅力号”这样先进的自主巡视器穿过干燥的多岩石湖床和陨石坑。装备有高分辨率光谱仪和岩石钻头，巡视器分析古代火星的地质。科学家寻找过去微观生命的生物特征证据，为未来的载人航天任务做准备。

questions.q: Which planet has been the prime destination for robotic space exploration?
What terrain do advanced rovers like Perseverance traverse?
options: Dry rocky lakebeds and meteor craters

questions.q: What tools do rovers carry to analyze Martian geology?
What evidence do scientists search for in Martian rock samples?
options: Biosignature evidence of past microbial life

questions.q: What ultimate goal does robotic Martian exploration support?
options: Prepare for future crewed human missions

text.en: Bioluminescence is the emission of light by living organisms through chemical reactions inside their cells. Deep ocean animals inhabiting perpetual darkness use glowing light flashes for hunting, camouflage, and defense. The anglerfish uses a glowing lure above its head to attract unsuspecting prey in pitch dark waters. Scientists study bioluminescent enzymes to create advanced medical imaging dyes and non-toxic lighting.
text.zh: 生物发光是活体生物通过细胞内的化学反应发射光线。生活在永恒黑暗中的深海动物使用发光闪光进行捕猎、伪装和防御。琵琶鱼使用头顶上方发光的诱饵在漆黑的水中吸引毫无防备的猎物。科学家研究生物发光酶，创造出先进的医学成像染料和无毒照明。

questions.q: What defines bioluminescence in marine life?
options: Emission of light through chemical reactions inside cells

questions.q: Why do deep ocean animals use glowing light flashes?
How does the anglerfish capture prey in pitch dark waters?
options: Uses a glowing lure above its head

questions.q: What practical tools do scientists develop from bioluminescent chemistry?
options: Advanced medical imaging dyes and non-toxic lighting

questions.q: What ocean zone do most bioluminescent creatures inhabit?

text.en: Airplane flight relies on fundamental aerodynamic principles involving four acting forces. Thrust generated by jet engines propels the aircraft forward against backward air drag resistance. Specially curved wings, called airfoils, force air to flow faster over top surfaces, creating upward lift. When upward lift exceeds downward gravity weight, the airplane achieves stable controlled flight.
text.zh: 飞机飞行依赖于涉及四种作用力的基本空气动力学原理。由喷气发动机产生的推力推动飞机向前，抵御向后的空气阻力。被称为翼型的特殊弯曲翅膀迫使空气在顶部表面流动得更快，从而创造出向上的升力。当向上的升力超过向下的重力重量时，飞机就实现了平稳的受控飞行。

questions.q: What four acting forces govern aerodynamic airplane flight?
options: Thrust, drag, lift, and gravity weight

questions.q: What force propels the aircraft forward against air drag resistance?
How do curved airfoil wings generate upward lift?
options: Forces air to flow faster over top surfaces creating low pressure

questions.q: When does an airplane achieve stable controlled flight in the air?
options: When upward lift exceeds downward gravity weight

questions.q: What term describes the specially curved shape of airplane wings?

text.en: The Amazon Basin encompasses the world's largest tropical rainforest and river network system. Its vast rainforest canopy acts as a critical global carbon sink, regulating planetary climate stability. Over one-tenth of all known species on Earth inhabit this rich biodiversity hotspot. Combating illegal deforestation in the Amazon is essential for preserving global ecological health.
text.zh: 亚马逊河流域拥有世界上最大的热带雨林和水系网络系统。其漫大的雨林树冠作为一个至关重要的全球碳汇，调节着行星的气候稳定。地球上超过十分之一的已知物种栖息在这个丰富的生物多样性热点地区。打击亚马逊地区非法砍伐森林对于维护全球生态健康至关重要。

questions.q: What ecosystem system does the Amazon Basin encompass?
options: World's largest tropical rainforest and river network

questions.q: How does the Amazon rainforest canopy regulate planetary climate stability?
options: Acts as a critical global carbon sink

questions.q: What fraction of Earth's known species inhabit the Amazon rainforest?
Why is combating illegal deforestation in the Amazon essential?
What type of environmental region is the Amazon rainforest classified as?

text.en: Movable type printing was pioneered by Bi Sheng in Song Dynasty China during the eleventh century. He carved individual Chinese characters onto durable ceramic clay blocks baked hard in ovens. Later Johannes Gutenberg developed the European mechanical printing press using metal type blocks. This revolutionary technology democratized access to books, spreading literacy and education across continents.
text.zh: 活字印刷术由中国宋朝的毕昇在十一世纪开创。他将单个汉字雕刻在经烤箱烤硬的耐用陶瓷黏土块上。后来，约翰内斯·谷登堡利用金属字块发明了欧洲机械印刷机。这项革命性的技术使书籍的获取大众化，在各个大洲传播了读写能力和教育。

questions.q: Who pioneered movable type printing in 11th century China?
What material did Bi Sheng carve individual Chinese characters onto?
Who developed the European mechanical printing press using metal type?
How did printing technology impact global education?
options: Democratized access to books and spread literacy

questions.q: During which century was movable type invented in China?

text.en: Hurricanes are immense thermodynamic storm systems generated over warm tropical ocean waters. Solar heat causes massive seawater evaporation, fueling humid rising air currents into spinning vortices. Central storm eyes remain remarkably calm while surrounding eyewall winds reach extreme destructive speeds. Satellite meteorology allows atmospheric scientists to model hurricane paths and issue life-saving evacuation warnings.
text.zh: 飓风是生成于温暖的热带海洋水域之上的巨大热力学风暴系统。太阳热量导致大量的海水蒸发，为湿润的上升气流提供燃料，形成旋转的涡旋。中央风暴眼保持着异常的平静，而周围的风暴壁风速则达到极具破坏性的速度。卫星气象学使大气科学家能够建模飓风路径，并发布救命的疏散预警。

questions.q: Where are hurricane storm systems generated?
What fuels the humid rising air currents in a hurricane?
options: Massive seawater evaporation caused by solar heat

questions.q: How is the central eye of a hurricane described?
How does satellite meteorology assist atmospheric scientists?
options: Models hurricane paths and issues evacuation warnings

questions.q: Where are extreme destructive winds concentrated in a hurricane?

text.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza stands as a monumental masterpiece of ancient structural engineering. Constructed during Pharaoh Khufu's reign, it required over two million massive stone blocks weighing tons. Egyptian builders aligned the pyramid's square base precisely with cardinal geographic directions. Ramps, wooden sledges, and massive workforce coordination enabled the placement of heavy granite blocks.
text.zh: 吉萨大金字塔作为古代结构工程的史诗级杰作耸立着。在法老胡夫统治时期建造，它需要超过两百万块重达数吨的巨型石块。埃及建造者将金字塔的正方形底部精确地与基准地理方向对齐。斜坡、木雪橇和浩大的劳动力协调使得重型花岗岩石块的放置成为可能。

How many massive stone blocks were used to build the Great Pyramid?
How did Egyptian builders align the pyramid's square base?
What tools and organization enabled the placement of heavy granite blocks?
options: Ramps, wooden sledges, and workforce coordination

questions.q: What material were the massive heavy blocks made of?

text.en: Renewable energy technologies harness continuous natural processes to generate clean electric power. Solar photovoltaic panels convert sunlight rays directly into electric current using silicon cells. Wind turbines capture moving atmospheric kinetic energy with large aerodynamic blades to drive generators. Hydroelectric facilities utilize gravitational water flow through turbines to produce reliable green electricity.
text.zh: 可再生能源技术利用持续的自然过程产生清洁电能。太阳能光伏电池板利用硅电池将太阳光线直接转换为电流。风力发电机利用大型空气动力学叶片捕捉移动的大气动能来驱动发电机。水利设施利用穿过水轮机的重力水流来生产可靠的绿色电力。

questions.q: What defines renewable energy technologies?
options: Harness continuous natural processes for clean electric power

questions.q: How do solar photovoltaic panels convert sunlight into current?
options: Using silicon cells converting rays directly

questions.q: What energy form do wind turbines capture with aerodynamic blades?
How do hydroelectric facilities generate green electricity?
options: Utilize gravitational water flow through turbines

questions.q: What environmental status is assigned to electricity from these sources?

text.en: The Great Barrier Reef off Australia is the world's largest living marine structure. Thousands of individual coral reefs are constructed by tiny reef-building coral polyps. Vibrant marine habitats support over fifteen hundred fish species, sea turtles, and marine mammals. Protecting coral reefs from climate warming and ocean acidification is critical for global biodiversity.
text.zh: 澳大利亚沿海的大堡礁是世界上最大的活体海洋结构。数以千计的独立珊瑚礁由微小的造礁珊瑚虫建造而成。充满活力的海洋栖息地滋养着一千五百多种鱼类、海龟和海洋哺乳动物。保护珊瑚礁免受气候变暖和海洋酸化的影响对于全球生物多样性至关重要。

What tiny organisms construct individual coral reefs?
How many fish species are supported by the reef habitat?
What threats make protecting coral reefs critical for biodiversity?
Where is the Great Barrier Reef located?

text.en: Modern airplane flight relies on fundamental aerodynamic principles governed by physics. Curved airfoil wings force air to flow faster over top surfaces during flight. Faster airflow creates lower pressure above the wing, producing upward lift force. Balancing lift, weight, thrust, and drag enables stable controlled flight across oceans.
text.zh: 现代飞机飞行依赖于由物理学主导的基本空气动力学原理。在飞行过程中，弯曲的翼型翅膀迫使空气在顶部表面流动得更快。较快的空气流在翅膀上方产生较低的压力，产生向上的升力。平衡升力、重力、推力和阻力使跨越海洋的平稳受控飞行成为可能。

What shape are airplane wings engineered into?
How does faster airflow over the wing affect pressure?

What four forces must be balanced for controlled flight?

text.en: Desert plants develop clever adaptations to survive hot weather and long droughts. Cacti have thick stems that store fresh water whenever it rains. Sharp spines protect the plant and keep precious water from evaporating. Deep root systems spread wide underground to collect rainwater quickly. These unique features allow cacti to grow well in dry deserts.
text.zh: 沙漠植物形成了聪明的适应能力，以在炎热天气和长期干旱中生存。仙人掌在下雨时拥有储存新鲜水份的厚茎。锋利的刺保护着植物，防止珍贵的水份蒸发。深根系统在地下广泛散开，以快速收集雨水。这些独特的特性使仙人掌能在干旱的沙漠中良好生长。

questions.q: Why do desert plants develop clever adaptations?
options: To survive hot weather and long droughts

questions.q: What part of the cactus stores fresh water?
Why do cacti have sharp spines?

text.en: Hurricanes are giant spinning storm systems that form over warm ocean waters. Heat from the sun causes ocean water to evaporate into warm humid air. Strong winds force the moist air to spin into a massive swirling storm. The center of the storm is called the calm eye. Scientists use weather satellites to track storms and warn people early.

What causes ocean water to evaporate into humid air?
What forces moist air to spin into a swirling storm?

text.en: Clean renewable energy comes from natural forces that never run out. Solar panels collect bright sunlight to make electricity for homes and schools. Giant wind turbines catch strong breezes to turn generators on windy hills. Water flowing through big dams also produces clean electrical power. Using clean energy cuts pollution and keeps our planet healthy.

options: Natural forces that never run out

questions.q: What do solar panels collect to make electricity?

Thousands of colorful fish, sea turtles, and whales live together in this ocean home. Small algae inside the coral polyps use sunlight to make fresh food. Protecting the reef from warm dirty water keeps ocean animals safe.

What tiny creatures build colorful coral reefs?

questions.q: During which dynasty was movable type printing invented?

text.en: Green plants use sunlight to make their own food through photosynthesis. Plant roots soak up fresh water and minerals from the dark soil. Leaves absorb carbon dioxide from the air and capture bright sun rays. Plants turn water and gas into sweet food and release clean oxygen. This important process gives humans and animals fresh air to breathe.
text.zh: 绿色植物通过光合作用利用阳光制造自己的食物。植物根部从黑暗的土壤中吸收新鲜的水和矿物质。树叶从空气中吸收二氧化碳，并捕捉明亮的阳光。植物将水和气体转化为甜美的食物，并释放出干净的氧气。这一重要的过程为人类和动物提供了呼吸的新鲜空气。

questions.q: How do green plants make their own food?
What do plant roots soak up from the soil?
What gas do plant leaves absorb from the air?
What clean gas do plants release for living creatures?
Why is photosynthesis an important natural process?
options: Gives humans and animals fresh air to breathe

questions.q: What sweet product do plants create from water and gas?

text.en: Mars is a rocky red planet that scientists explore using robotic rovers. Rovers like Perseverance drive across dry lakebeds and take clear photos. Powerful drills on the rovers collect rock samples for laboratory testing. Scientists look for ancient clues of water and tiny living cells on Mars. These exciting space discoveries help prepare astronauts for future space travel.
text.zh: 火星是一颗多岩石的红星，科学家们使用机器人巡视器进行探索。像“毅力号”这样的巡视器穿过干涸的湖床，拍摄清晰的照片。巡视器上强大的钻头收集岩石样本用于实验室检测。科学家在火星上寻找古老水域和微小活细胞的线索。这些令人兴奋的太空发现有助于为未来的太空旅行准备宇航员。

questions.q: What kind of planet is Mars?
What robot drives across dry lakebeds on Mars?
What tool collects rock samples for testing?
What ancient clues do scientists look for on Mars?
options: Clues of water and tiny living cells

questions.q: Who do these space discoveries help prepare for future travel?
What photos do rovers take on Mars?

text.en: Deep ocean animals live in complete pitch darkness thousands of meters underwater. Many deep sea fish create their own glowing light using simple body chemicals. Anglerfish wave a glowing light above their heads to attract tiny fish in the dark. Other ocean creatures flash bright lights to scare away hungry predators. Scientists study glowing sea life to create helpful new medical tools.
text.zh: 深海动物生活在水下数千米完全漆黑的环境中。许多深海鱼类使用简单的身体化学物质产生自己的发光。琵琶鱼在头顶上方挥舞发光的灯，在黑暗中吸引小鱼。其他海洋生物闪烁明亮的灯光来吓退饥饿的捕食者。科学家研究发光的海洋生物，以创造有帮助的新医学工具。

questions.q: What light conditions exist deep in the ocean?
How do deep sea fish create glowing light?
Why does an anglerfish wave a glowing light above its head?
options: To attract tiny fish in the dark

questions.q: Why do some ocean creatures flash bright lights?
What practical creation comes from studying glowing sea life?
Where do anglerfish live?
options: Thousands of meters underwater in dark ocean

text.en: Airplanes fly smoothly through the sky using basic rules of science. Powerful jet engines push the airplane forward against backward air resistance. Curved wings make air move faster over the top than under the bottom. Faster air creates lower pressure above the wing, lifting the plane into the sky. Balancing thrust, drag, weight, and lift keeps the airplane flying safely.
text.zh: 飞机利用科学的基本规律在空中平稳飞行。强大的喷气发动机推动飞机向前，抵抗向后的空气阻力。弯曲的翅膀使空气在顶部流动得比在底部更快。较快的空气在翅膀上方产生较低的压力，将飞机抬提升空。平衡推力、阻力、重力和升力使飞机安全飞行。

questions.q: What pushes an airplane forward against air resistance?
How does air move over the curved wing of a plane?
options: Faster over top than under bottom

questions.q: What is created by faster air moving over the top wing?
options: Lower pressure lifting plane into sky

questions.q: What four forces must be balanced for safe flight?
What term describes the force that lifts the plane upward?
Why do airplane wings have a curved shape?
options: To make air flow faster over top for lift

text.en: The Amazon Basin is the biggest tropical rainforest and river region on Earth. Millions of tall trees form a green roof that absorbs carbon dioxide gas. Over one-tenth of all known animal species live in this rich forest habitat. Indigenous people have lived in harmony with the forest trees for hundreds of years. Protecting the Amazon rainforest from being cut down protects our global climate.
text.zh: 亚马逊流域是地球上最大的热带雨林和河流区域。数以百万计的高大树木形成绿色屋顶，吸收二氧化碳气体。超过十分之一的已知动物物种生活在这个丰富的森林栖息地。土著人在数百年的时间里与森林树木和谐共处。保护亚马逊雨林不被砍伐，可以保护我们的全球气候。

questions.q: What is the Amazon Basin recognized as?
options: Biggest tropical rainforest and river region

questions.q: What do millions of tall trees absorb from the air?
What fraction of known animal species live in the Amazon forest?
How long have indigenous people lived in harmony with the forest?
Why is protecting the Amazon rainforest important for the planet?
What forms a green roof high in the forest?

text.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza is a massive historic monument built in ancient Egypt. Workers moved over two million heavy stone blocks to build the pharaoh's tomb. Builders aligned the square base of the pyramid carefully with true directions. Ramps and wooden sleds helped teams of workers lift heavy granite stones. Today visitors and historians travel to Egypt to admire these stone wonders.
text.zh: 吉萨大金字塔建造于古埃及，是一座宏伟的历史遗迹。工人们挪动了两百万块沉重的石块来建造法老的陵墓。建造者仔细地将金字塔的正方形底部与基准方向对齐。斜坡和木雪橇帮助工人团队抬升沉重的花岗岩石块。今天，游客和历史学家前往埃及观赏这些石造奇迹。

questions.q: Where was the Great Pyramid of Giza constructed?
How many heavy stone blocks were moved to build the pyramid?
What was the original purpose of building the Great Pyramid?
options: As a tomb for the pharaoh

questions.q: What tools helped worker teams lift heavy granite stones?
Why do visitors and historians travel to Egypt today?
options: To admire these historic stone wonders

questions.q: What shape is the base of the Great Pyramid?

text.en: Ocean currents are giant rivers of seawater that flow across Earth's oceans. Wind, water temperature, and Earth's rotation push these ocean currents forward. Warm currents carry tropical heat toward cold polar areas to balance weather. Whales, sea turtles, and fish swim along currents during long travel journeys. Understanding ocean currents helps weather experts predict rain and storms.
text.zh: 洋流是流经地球海洋的巨大海水河流。风、水温和地球自转推动着这些洋流前行。暖流将热带热量带往寒冷的极地地区，以平衡天气。鲸鱼、海龟和鱼类在漫长的旅行途中沿着洋流游泳。了解洋流有助于天气专家预测降雨和风暴。

questions.q: What are ocean currents described as?
What natural forces push ocean currents forward?
Where do warm currents carry tropical heat?
options: Toward cold polar areas to balance weather

questions.q: Which ocean animals swim along currents during long journeys?
How does understanding ocean currents help weather experts?
What do warm currents help balance on Earth?

text.en: Water on Earth moves continuously in a natural cycle that never stops. Heat from the sun warms ocean water, changing liquid water into invisible gas. Rising water vapor cools down high in the sky to form rain clouds. Heavy clouds drop fresh rain or snow that fills rivers, lakes, and streams. River water flows back into the sea to start the cycle again.
text.zh: 地球上的水在一个从不停歇的自然循环中不断运动。来自太阳的热量使海水变暖，将液态水转化为看不见的气体。上升的水蒸气在天空中高处冷却下来，形成雨云。沉重的云层落下新鲜的雨雪，填满河流、湖泊和溪流。河水流回大海，再次开启循环。

questions.q: How does water move on Earth?
options: Continuously in a natural cycle that never stops

questions.q: What changes liquid ocean water into invisible gas?
What forms high in the sky when rising water vapor cools?
What drops from heavy clouds to fill rivers and lakes?
Where does river water flow to restart the cycle?
What form is water in after sun heat warms it?

text.en: Electric vehicles use rechargeable batteries instead of noisy gasoline engines. Drivers plug electric cars into power stations charged by solar panels or wind power. Electric cars produce no dirty exhaust smoke, keeping city air clean and fresh. Car makers build faster, safer, and cheaper electric vehicles every single year. Clean electric transportation helps protect the environment for future generations.
text.zh: 电动汽车使用可充电电池，而不是吵闹的汽油发动机。司机将电动汽车插入由太阳能电池板或风力发电机充电的供电站。电动汽车不产生脏污的尾气烟雾，保持城市空气干净清新。汽车制造商每年都在制造更快、更安全、更便宜的电动汽车。清洁的电力交通有助于为后代保护环境。

questions.q: What powers electric vehicles instead of gasoline engines?
How do drivers charge electric cars at power stations?
options: Plug into stations charged by solar or wind

questions.q: How do electric cars help keep city air clean and fresh?
What improvements do car makers build every single year?
options: Faster, safer, and cheaper electric vehicles

questions.q: Why is clean electric transportation beneficial for the future?
options: Helps protect the environment for future generations

questions.q: What clean energy sources charge electric vehicle stations?

text.en: Eight planets travel around our bright sun in predictable oval orbits. Earth is the third planet from the sun and has liquid water and breathable air. Gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn have thick clouds and colorful ring systems. Astronomers use space telescopes to discover distant exoplanets near far stars. Studying the solar system helps humans learn more about outer space.
text.zh: 八颗行星在可预测的椭圆形轨道上绕着我们明亮的太阳运转。地球是离太阳第三近的行星，拥有液态水和可呼吸的空气。像木星和土星这样的气体巨星拥有厚厚的云层和绚丽的环系统。天文学家使用太空望远镜发现遥远恒星附近的远方外星行星。研究太阳系有助于人类更多地了解外太空。

questions.q: How many planets travel around our sun in oval orbits?
Which planet is third from the sun and has liquid water?
Which planets have thick clouds and colorful ring systems?
options: Gas giants like Jupiter and Saturn

questions.q: What tool do astronomers use to discover distant exoplanets?
Why do humans study our solar system?
options: To learn more about outer space

questions.q: What shape are the planetary orbits around the sun?

desc.en: Have/Has + past participle for past actions with present relevance.
desc.zh: Have/Has + 过去分词表示过去发生且影响现在的动作。

rule.en: Use 'have/has' + past participle for past experiences or unfinished time periods.
rule.zh: 使用 'have/has' + 过去分词表达经历或尚未结束的时间段内的动作。

questions.q: I ___ finished my homework already.
She ___ lived in Beijing for five years.
They ___ visited the Great Wall twice.
He ___ lost his house key.
We ___ known each other since primary school.
___ you ever seen a panda in real life?
She ___ already read that adventure book.

title.zh: 现在完成时：For 与 Since

desc.en: For + duration, Since + starting point.
desc.zh: For 接一段时间，Since 接时间起点。

rule.en: Use 'for' to state a length of time (for 3 years) and 'since' for a specific starting moment (since 2020).
rule.zh: 'for' 后面接具体时间段，'since' 后面接时间起点。

questions.q: I have been here ___ two hours.
She has lived here ___ 2018.
We have known Tom ___ a long time.
He has been sick ___ last Monday.
They have played soccer ___ 30 minutes.
I haven't seen her ___ yesterday morning.
Mr. Wang has taught English ___ ten years.

desc.en: Had + past participle for an action before another past event.
desc.zh: Had + 过去分词表示在过去某一时间点之前已完成的动作。

rule.en: Use 'had' + past participle for an action completed before another past action.
rule.zh: 使用 'had' + 过去分词描述在另一个过去动作之前已完成的事（过去的过去）。

questions.q: When I arrived at the station, the train ___ left.
She ___ finished her dinner before the movie started.
By the time we got home, Mom ___ cooked meal.
He told me that he ___ lost his wallet.
They ___ lived in London before moving to Paris.
The sun ___ set before we reached the mountain top.
I realized that I ___ forgotten my notebook.

desc.en: Be + past participle (The book was written by...).
desc.zh: Be + 过去分词（焦点在动作承受者）。

rule.en: Use passive voice (be + past participle) when the focus is on the object receiving the action.
rule.zh: 当焦点在于动作承受者时使用被动语态（be + 过去分词）。

questions.q: The window ___ broken by the baseball yesterday.
English is ___ all over the world.
The bridge was ___ in 1995.
These letters were ___ by my sister.
The cake was ___ by my mom this morning.
The lost dog was ___ in the park.
The prize was ___ to the top student.

desc.en: If + present simple, will + base verb.
desc.zh: If + 一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

rule.en: Use 'If + simple present, will + verb' for real future possibilities.
rule.zh: 表达将来的真实可能性：If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

questions.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ stay inside.
If you study hard, you ___ pass the exam.
If she ___ early, we will go together.
They will win the game if they ___ well.
If I see him, I ___ tell him the news.
We will have a picnic if the weather ___ nice.
If he ___ fast, he will catch the bus.

desc.en: If + past simple, would + base verb.
desc.zh: If + 过去时，主句用 would + 动词原形。

rule.en: Use 'If + simple past, would + verb' for imaginary or hypothetical situations.
rule.zh: 表达非真实或假设情况：If 从句用过去时，主句用 would + 动词原形。

questions.q: If I had a million dollars, I ___ buy a big boat.
If she ___ a bird, she would fly to Hawaii.
They would travel the world if they ___ rich.
If I ___ his number, I would call him.
He would help us if he ___ time.
If we lived near the beach, we ___ swim every day.
If you ___ harder, you would get better marks.

desc.en: Who for people, Which/That for things.
desc.zh: Who 代指人，Which/That 代指物。

rule.en: Use 'who' for people and 'which' or 'that' for things or animals.
rule.zh: 定语从句中修饰人用 'who'，修饰物或动物用 'which' 或 'that'。

questions.q: The girl ___ won the race is my friend.
The book ___ I bought yesterday is interesting.
This is the doctor ___ saved my dog.
Look at the car ___ is parked outside.
The boy ___ sits next to me is smart.
I love the sweater ___ you are wearing.
The place ___ we met was very quiet.

desc.en: Report what someone said.
desc.zh: 转述他人的话语。

rule.en: When reporting speech in the past, shift present tense verbs to past tense.
rule.zh: 转述过去的话语时，时态通常向过去推移（如 am/is -> was）。

questions.q: Tom said, 'I am tired.' -> Tom said that he ___ tired.
Mary said, 'I like ice cream.' -> Mary said that she ___ ice cream.
He said, 'We are ready.' -> He said that they ___ ready.
She told me, 'I will call you.' -> She told me that she ___ call me.
Ben said, 'I have finished.' -> Ben said that he ___ finished.
The teacher said that the sun ___ in the east.
They said, 'We can win.' -> They said that they ___ win.

desc.en: Verb + -ing vs To + base verb.
desc.zh: 动词-ing 与 To + 动词原形。

rule.en: Some verbs are followed by gerunds (enjoy reading) and others by infinitives (decide to go).
rule.zh: 部分动词后接动名词（如 enjoy doing），部分动词后接不定式（如 decide to do）。

questions.q: She enjoys ___ books on rainy days.
We decided ___ to Beijing by train.
He promised ___ me tomorrow.
They finished ___ their room at noon.
I want ___ a new song on guitar.
Avoid ___ noise in the study hall.
She hopes ___ a doctor in the future.

desc.en: Confirm information at the end of a sentence.
desc.zh: 句末附加疑问成分确认信息。

rule.en: Use negative question tags after positive statements, and positive tags after negative statements.
rule.zh: 前肯后否，前否后肯（如 You are ready, aren't you?）。

questions.q: You are a student, ___ you?
He is very smart, ___ he?
They don't like milk, ___ they?
She can play piano, ___ she?
You haven't seen Tom today, ___ you?
We passed the exam, ___ we?
It is a beautiful day, ___ it?

title.en: Modals of Deduction: Must / Can't / Might

desc.en: Express how certain you are about something.
desc.zh: 表达对事件确信程度的推测。

rule.en: Use 'must be' when 100% sure something is true, and 'can't be' when 100% sure it is impossible.
rule.zh: 'must be' 表示肯定推测（一定是），'can't be' 表示否定推测（不可能）。

questions.q: He has three sports cars. He ___ be very rich.
That ___ be Mary. She is in London today!
Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
She has studied all day. She ___ be tired.
You just ate lunch! You ___ be hungry already.
He is not answering. He ___ be asleep.
The lights are off. They ___ be at home.

desc.en: Express contrast (although) vs reason (because).
desc.zh: 表达转折让步（although）与原因（because）。

rule.en: Use 'although' for surprising contrast and 'because' for explanations.
rule.zh: 'although' 表示尽管（转折让步），'because' 表示因为（原因解释）。

questions.q: ___ it was raining, he went out without an umbrella.
I stayed at home ___ I felt sick.
___ she was tired, she kept working hard.
He passed the test ___ he studied thoroughly.
___ he is young, he is very wise.
We enjoyed the picnic ___ the wind was chilly.
They won the match ___ they practiced together.

desc.en: Singular subjects take singular verbs.
desc.zh: 单数主语用单数谓语，复数用复数。

rule.en: Words like 'everyone', 'each', and 'neither' take singular verbs (is, has, runs).
rule.zh: 包含 everyone, each, neither 等不定代词作为主语时用单数谓语动词。

questions.q: Everyone in the class ___ happy today.
Each of the boys ___ a new bike.
Neither of the answers ___ correct.
One of my friends ___ living in Paris.
The group of students ___ walking to school.
Everyone ___ to win the game.
Neither Tom nor his brothers ___ present.

desc.en: Make/let someone do something.
desc.zh: 让/使某人做某事（使役句型）。

rule.en: Use make/let/have + object + base verb (without 'to').
rule.zh: 使用 make/let/have + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to）。

questions.q: Mom made me ___ my bedroom.
The teacher let us ___ outside early.
Please have him ___ me back.
Don't let the dog ___ out.
He made his sister ___.
Our boss made us ___ late yesterday.
Let me ___ you with your bag.

desc.en: Never have I seen... for strong emphasis.
desc.zh: 否定副词置于句首时的部分倒装。

rule.en: When a sentence starts with negative adverbs (Never, Seldom), invert subject and auxiliary verb.
rule.zh: 否定副词（Never, Seldom）置于句首时，主语和助动词倒装。

questions.q: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful sunrise.
Seldom ___ he visit the museum.
Not only ___ she smart, but she is also kind.
Little ___ they know about the surprise party.
Never ___ we heard such a loud sound.
Hardly ___ I arrived when the phone rang.
Rarely ___ she eat fast food.

writing.en: If you could invent a new piece of technology to help students learn, what would it be and how would it work?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一项帮助学生学习的新技术，那会是什么？它是如何运作的？

writing.en: How do you think artificial intelligence will change schools in the next twenty years?
writing.zh: 你认为人工智能在未来二十年里会如何改变学校？

writing.en: Write about a world where people only communicate through screens. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
writing.zh: 写一个人们只通过屏幕交流的世界。有什么优点和缺点？

writing.en: If you had a personal robot assistant, what tasks would you give it and why?
writing.zh: 如果你有一个私人机器人助手，你会让它做什么任务？为什么？

writing.en: Imagine a new form of green energy is discovered. How does it power our cities and vehicles?
writing.zh: 想象发现了一种新型绿色能源。它如何为我们的城市和车辆提供动力？

writing.en: Do you think video games can be educational? Explain your thoughts with examples.
writing.zh: 你认为电子游戏有教育意义吗？用例子解释你的想法。

writing.en: Describe a smart home of the future. What special features does it have in each room?
writing.zh: 描述一个未来的智能家居。每个房间有什么特色？

writing.en: If you could have any superpower, what would it be and how would you use it to help people?
writing.zh: 如果你可以拥有一种超能力，它会是什么？你会如何用它来帮助别人？

writing.en: If you could design a new app for smartphones, what problem would it solve?
writing.zh: 如果你能为智能手机设计一款新应用，它能解决什么问题？

writing.en: How has the internet changed the way we find information? Is it always a reliable source?
writing.zh: 互联网如何改变了我们寻找信息的方式？它总是一个可靠的来源吗？

writing.en: Why is it important to protect the environment? Share three things you can do every day to help.
writing.zh: 为什么保护环境很重要？分享三件你每天可以做的有助于环保的事情。

writing.en: Imagine you are a sea turtle swimming in the ocean. Describe the impact of plastic pollution on your life.
writing.zh: 想象你是一只在海里游泳的海龟。描述塑料污染对你生活的影响。

writing.en: What are the benefits of planting more trees in urban areas? How would it change the city environment?
writing.zh: 在城市地区种植更多树木有什么好处？它将如何改变城市环境？

writing.en: Write a persuasive paragraph encouraging your classmates to recycle and reduce waste.
writing.zh: 写一段有说服力的段落，鼓励你的同学回收利用并减少浪费。

writing.en: How does climate change affect animals living in the Arctic? What can we do to slow it down?
writing.zh: 气候变化如何影响生活在北极的动物？我们能做些什么来减缓它？

writing.en: If you were the mayor of a city, what laws would you pass to make the city more eco-friendly?
writing.zh: 如果你是一个城市的市长，你会通过什么法律让城市更加环保？

writing.en: Describe the importance of conserving water. What are some creative ways to save water at home?
writing.zh: 描述节约用水的重要性。在家里有哪些有创意的节水方法？

writing.en: Write about a time you participated in a nature cleanup or wish you had. What was the experience like?
writing.zh: 写一次你参加（或希望参加）大自然清理活动的经历。那次经历是怎样的？

writing.en: How do human activities threaten endangered species? Choose one animal to focus on.
writing.zh: 人类活动如何威胁濒危物种？选择一种动物进行重点讨论。

writing.en: What would happen if all the bees in the world disappeared? Explain the impact on our food supply.
writing.zh: 如果世界上所有的蜜蜂都消失了会发生什么？解释对我们食物供应的影响。

writing.en: Imagine you are an astronaut traveling to Mars. What are your feelings as you leave Earth, and what do you hope to discover?
writing.zh: 想象一下你是一名去火星旅行的宇航员。当你离开地球时，你有什么感觉？你希望能发现什么？

writing.en: If you could visit any planet in our solar system, which one would you choose and what would you look for?
writing.zh: 如果你能参观我们太阳系中的任何行星，你会选择哪一个？你会寻找什么？

writing.en: Write a story about finding a strange message from an alien civilization. How do you decode it?
writing.zh: 写一个关于收到来自外星文明的奇怪信息的故事。你如何解码它？

writing.en: What qualities make a good astronaut? Do you think you have what it takes for a space mission?
writing.zh: 什么品质造就了一个好的宇航员？你认为你具备执行太空任务的条件吗？

writing.en: Describe a typical day living on a space station orbiting the Earth. What are the challenges?
writing.zh: 描述在绕地球运行的空间站上生活的典型一天。有哪些挑战？

writing.en: Do you think humans should try to colonize other planets? Why or why not?
writing.zh: 你认为人类应该尝试在其他星球上殖民吗？为什么应该或为什么不应该？

writing.en: Imagine you are the first person to walk on a newly discovered moon. What are your first words?
writing.zh: 想象你是第一个踏上新发现的卫星的人。你的第一句话是什么？

writing.en: How does studying space help us understand our own planet better?
writing.zh: 研究太空如何帮助我们更好地了解我们自己的星球？

writing.en: If you could design a new spaceship, what special features would it need for deep space travel?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一艘新的宇宙飞船，进行深空旅行需要什么特殊功能？

writing.en: Write a journal entry as a space explorer who just encountered a black hole for the first time.
writing.zh: 作为一名刚刚首次遇到黑洞的太空探索者写一篇日记。

writing.en: What is your dream job for the future? Explain why you want this career and what skills you will need.
writing.zh: 你未来梦想的工作是什么？解释你为什么想要这份职业，以及你需要什么技能。

writing.en: If you could shadow a professional in your dream field for a day, who would it be and what would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能跟随你梦想领域的专业人士一天，那会是谁？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: How do you plan to achieve your career goals? Describe the steps you need to take in your education.
writing.zh: 你打算如何实现你的职业目标？描述你在教育中需要采取的步骤。

writing.en: Write about a job that doesn't exist yet but might be common in 2050. What does the job involve?
writing.zh: 写一份现在还不存在，但在2050年可能很普遍的工作。这份工作包括什么？

writing.en: Why is teamwork important in almost any career? Give an example of how you work well with others.
writing.zh: 为什么团队合作在几乎所有职业中都很重要？举例说明你是如何与他人良好合作的。

writing.en: Describe a time when you failed at something but learned a valuable lesson for your future.
writing.zh: 描述一次你做某事失败但为你未来学到了宝贵教训的经历。

writing.en: What role does creativity play in a scientific or technical career? Explain your viewpoint.
writing.zh: 创造力在科学或技术职业中扮演什么角色？解释你的观点。

writing.en: If you had to choose between a highly paid job you dislike or a low-paying job you love, which would you pick and why?
writing.zh: 如果必须在你不喜欢的高薪工作和热爱但低薪的工作之间做出选择，你会选哪个？为什么？

writing.en: How can you use your future career to make a positive impact on the world?
writing.zh: 你如何利用未来的职业对世界产生积极影响？

writing.en: What skills do you think will be most important for jobs in the future? How can you learn them now?
writing.zh: 你认为哪些技能对未来的工作最重要？你现在该如何学习它们？

writing.en: If you could travel back in time to witness any historical event, which one would you choose and why?
writing.zh: 如果你能回到过去见证任何历史事件，你会选择哪一个？为什么？

writing.en: Imagine you are a sailor on Christopher Columbus's ship. Describe your feelings when you first see land.
writing.zh: 想象你是克里斯托弗·哥伦布船上的一名水手。描述你第一次看到陆地时的感受。

writing.en: Write about a historical figure who fought for civil rights. How did their actions change society?
writing.zh: 写一位为民权奋斗的历史人物。他们的行动如何改变了社会？

writing.en: If you lived during the Industrial Revolution, what would your daily life look like in a growing city?
writing.zh: 如果你生活在工业革命时期，你在不断发展的城市中的日常生活会是怎样的？

writing.en: Describe the construction of the Great Wall of China from the perspective of a worker.
writing.zh: 从一名工人的角度描述中国长城的修建过程。

writing.en: How did the invention of the printing press change the way knowledge was shared?
writing.zh: 印刷术的发明是如何改变知识传播方式的？

writing.en: Write a letter to a friend describing your experience witnessing the first airplane flight by the Wright brothers.
writing.zh: 写信给朋友，描述你见证莱特兄弟第一次飞机飞行的经历。

writing.en: Why is it important for us to study history? What lessons can we learn from past mistakes?
writing.zh: 为什么学习历史对我们很重要？我们可以从过去的错误中吸取什么教训？

writing.en: Imagine you are a reporter during the moon landing in 1969. Write the opening paragraph of your news article.
writing.zh: 想象你是1969年登月期间的一名记者。写下你新闻报道的开篇段落。

writing.en: Choose a historical mystery (like the Pyramids or Stonehenge). What is your theory on how it was built?
writing.zh: 选择一个历史谜团（如金字塔或巨石阵）。关于它是如何建造的，你的理论是什么？

writing.en: Describe a time when you faced a difficult problem. How did you use creative thinking to solve it?
writing.zh: 描述一次你面临难题的经历。你是如何用创造性思维来解决它的？

writing.en: You are lost in a dense forest with a compass, a water bottle, and a flashlight. How do you find your way out?
writing.zh: 你带着指南针、水壶和手电筒在茂密的森林中迷路了。你如何找到出路？

writing.en: Your community center needs to raise money for a new playground. Pitch a unique fundraising event.
writing.zh: 你们的社区中心需要为新操场筹集资金。提出一个独特的筹款活动。

writing.en: Imagine a bridge collapses, separating your town in half. What temporary solution can you design to keep people connected?
writing.zh: 想象一座桥塌了，把你的小镇分成了两半。你能设计什么临时解决方案让人们保持联系？

writing.en: You have been tasked with inventing a machine that cleans up ocean plastic. How does it work without harming sea life?
writing.zh: 你被派去发明一种清理海洋塑料的机器。它是如何在不伤害海洋生物的情况下工作的？

writing.en: Your school cafeteria is producing too much food waste. Propose a system to reduce and reuse the leftovers.
writing.zh: 学校食堂产生了太多的食物垃圾。提出一个减少和重新利用剩菜的系统。

writing.en: If you were locked in a museum overnight, how would you keep yourself safe and entertained using the exhibits?
writing.zh: 如果你被整夜锁在博物馆里，你将如何利用展品来保证自己的安全并自娱自乐？

writing.en: Design a new sport that combines elements of soccer and swimming. What are the rules?
writing.zh: 设计一项结合足球和游泳元素的新运动。规则是什么？

writing.en: A spaceship has crash-landed in your backyard. How do you communicate with the aliens who only speak in colors?
writing.zh: 一艘宇宙飞船在你的后院坠毁。你如何与只会用颜色交流的外星人沟通？

writing.en: You need to teach a complex math concept to a group of first graders. Describe a fun game you would use to explain it.
writing.zh: 你需要给一群一年级学生教一个复杂的数学概念。描述一个你会用来解释这个概念的有趣游戏。
